teamsAppDefinition.shortDescription: A conversational smart assistant from MSX that surfaces real-time insights.
teamsAppDefinition.description: For MSX Users: A conversational role-based smart assistant that will enable Enterprise sellers (AE, ATS, SSP, TSP) to be more productive by surfacing real-time insights, recommendations, actions and notifications, and by automating repetitive tasks.

value.description: Example application

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Designer: Collaborative AI-driven Image Creator in Microsoft Teams.
appDefinitions.description: Designer brings its AI-driven features to Microsoft Teams chat, transforming the way users create images. Beyond simply generating visuals from text prompts, this tool facilitates real-time collaborative refinements to the images, making certain the final output aligns with the collective requirements of all participants. Seamlessly incorporated into Teams chat, Designer enhances efficiency and injects a lively creative flair into conversations, establishing it as an essential tool for modern communication. (Available in the US)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Glint helps to foster a culture of continuous feedback and employee engagement.
appDefinitions.description:
Depending on your role, here are some things Glint Bot can notify you about in Microsoft Teams:
- When a Glint survey has started
- When survey results are ready
- When it's time to choose a Focus Area
- When it's time to check in with your team about survey results or about progress against Focus Areas
Glint bot in Teams can go beyond survey reminders and can deliver Nudges to take meaningful action and drive positive behavior. Remind team members to view results, share survey results with their teams, and create Focus Areas.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Find new ways to leverage your organization’s knowledge with Microsoft Topics
appDefinitions.description: Leverage the power of knowledge and expertise in your organization with Microsoft Topics. With the new Topics Notifications bot, you’ll stay up to date on new ways to share, learn, and contribute to topics in your organization. You’ll also receive notifications about topics that may be relevant to your work and expertise, helping you boost your productivity and personal growth.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Communicate efficiently with Defender Experts
appDefinitions.description: Defender Experts provides managed hunting, detection, and response services that complement the Microsoft Defender XDR site of products and solutions. Use this app to get notifications and communicate with our experts about managed response activities for your critical security incidents. Learn more about Defender Experts

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Easily create surveys, quizzes and polls.
appDefinitions.description:
Forms empower you to collect better data and make better decisions. Use Forms in Teams to:
* Create effective forms with easy-to-use tools and clear design suggestions.
* Get quick feedback or collect more detailed information with branching questions.
* Instantly visualize response data and advanced analysis.
* Stay connected from any browser on any device—no matter where you are.
* Assess student progress with quizzes and easily export answers to Excel.
* Launch a poll in your meeting/chat to collect real-time feedbacks and better engage with participants.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Be more productive with Microsoft Power Automate
appDefinitions.description: Automate time-consuming and repetitive tasks by integrating your favorite apps and services with Microsoft Power Automate.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Receive alerts on your organization's data
appDefinitions.description:
With Activator in Microsoft Fabric, you can track your organization's data and drive timely actions. Use the Activator Microsoft Teams app to receive alerts when an Activator rule triggers.
Activator is now generally available. Try out today by setting alert on Power BI or visit [https://fabric.microsoft.com](https://fabric.microsoft.com).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Easily create polls with your team in Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
Easily create choice polls, quizzes and word cloud polls before or during your meeting. Collect responses in real-time.

[Get Started](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2270227) | [Get Help](https://support.microsoft.com/forms)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: This is an agent created based on the sources selected by its owner.
appDefinitions.description: Agents are created and customized based on the sources selected, including SharePoint sites, documents, and other files. Users can start conversations with these agents directly from a SharePoint site or by adding an agent to a Teams group chat and get the support they need to optimize their productivity with AI.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Configure, distribute, and manage your Microsoft Teams apps.
appDefinitions.description:
Formerly App Studio the Developer Portal can help wherever you are in your Microsoft Teams app development journey.

1. Set up a new app or import an existing one.
2. Configure your app's capabilities and other important metadata.
3. Get resources to help you build a high-quality app.
3. Test your app directly in Teams.
4. Distribute your app to your org or the Teams store.
5. Analyze your app’s usage, engagement, and other insights.

The portal also includes tools for designing custom virtual scenes, Adaptive Cards, and integrating with the Microsoft identity platform.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Send your team a pulse, and receive feedback in under two minutes.
appDefinitions.description: Microsoft Viva Pulse empowers managers and project team leaders to request and receive feedback from their teams at any time. Choose a research based template to quickly create your pulse and send it to select individuals, or an entire group. Receive confidential feedback from your team, and take immediate strategic action to promote increased employee engagement and wellbeing.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Provides Microsoft Dataverse access to sync chats connected to Dataverse records
appDefinitions.description: Provides Microsoft Dataverse access to sync Microsoft Teams chats connected to Dataverse records (rows). Synchronized chat metadata such as who last updated a chat and when it was updated is made available in Dataverse. Chat message content is not synchronized.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Monitor and collaborate on existing work items and create new work items.
appDefinitions.description:
Azure Boards enables you to plan, track and discuss work across your teams. Azure Boards app for Microsoft Teams lets you monitor work item activity in your projects, create new work items, search and share work items with your colleagues and get previews of work items using URLs.
Features- Connect a Teams channel to an Azure DevOps project.
- Subscribe to notifications for work items in the project.
- Create new work items from your Teams channel.
- Use the messaging extension to search for and share work items with colleagues.
- Get URL previews for work items.
Note:In order to use this app, users must have an active Azure DevOps account. Users must have sufficient permissions and must be part of the organization to access the app functionality. Contact the organization admin for any concerns. For queries or feedback, refer to the documentation at Azure DevOps User Guide - Provide Feedback

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Create and manage approvals in Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description: The hub for your approvals across all systems that you create, manage, and share. Get things done quickly with the ability to review and take action right in Microsoft Teams. To use this app, you need to have an F3 license or above. Contact your admin if you're unable to use the app.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Updates app helps users easily track team work status and gain insights.
appDefinitions.description: Updates is a Microsoft app designed to help users effortlessly track their teams' work status and gain insights by collecting and reviewing work reports from team members. Whether you need to manage regular recurring processes or ad-hoc reports required at a moment's notice, the Updates app streamlines everything in one convenient place.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Connect your team with the data they use most using Power Apps
appDefinitions.description: Help your team work smarter by creating apps that connect to the data they use most. Add those apps to your channel so your team can quickly find them.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Outgoing Webhooks help communicate with apps outside Microsoft Teams.
appDefinitions.description: Webhooks are a great way for Teams to integrate with external apps. A webhook is essentially a POST request sent to a callback URL. In Teams, outgoing webhooks provide a simple way to allow users to send messages to your web service without having to go through the full process of creating bots via the Microsoft Bot Framework. Outgoing webhooks post data from Teams to any chosen service capable of accepting a JSON payload. Once an outgoing webhook is added to a team, it acts like bot, listening in channels for messages using @mention, sending notifications to external web services, and responding with rich messages that can include cards and images.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Customer Connect streamlines your customer service requests.
appDefinitions.description: Add the Customer Connect bot to Microsoft Teams to streamline and triage your customer service request and get them assigned to a customer service agent to quickly resolve your customer's needs. To set up this app, you must have admin access to your organization's Teams accounts. To learn more, go to [https://aka.ms/TeamscustomerserviceforSMBs](https://aka.ms/TeamscustomerserviceforSMBs)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Microsoft 365 Copilot for Sales reimagines the way sellers work.
appDefinitions.description:
Microsoft 365 Copilot for Sales is an AI assistant designed for sellers to maximize productivity and close more deals. It brings next-generation AI and sales insights from their CRM platform into the Microsoft 365 productivity tools that they use daily like Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft Word. Sellers will be able to work more efficiently and improve customer experiences with email assistance, personalized sales content creation, AI-generated insights, and recommendations for next steps. Sales managers can empower their teams with AI-powered manager insights and collaboration tools.  Copilot for Sales can also be customized according to your business needs. Copilot for Sales integrates seamlessly with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales and Salesforce Sales Cloud, and can be configured to connect to other sales solutions.

A Microsoft 365 Global Administrator is required to install and set up Copilot for Sales. Copilot for Sales may be subject to an additional free or paid license. For more details, please access the Copilot for Sales website or contact your Microsoft representative. 

Copilot for Sales allows administrators and users to access content and share data outside of Microsoft 365, including with third-party customer relationship management (CRM) services. Such data sharing is subject to Microsoft and applicable third-party CRM terms and conditions. Data sharing is not enabled until administrators and users in your organization consent to connect their Microsoft work or school account with their CRM account. 

Copilot for Sales for Microsoft Teams will have permission to participate in Teams meetings and collect Teams meetings data such as meeting recordings and transcripts. 

**Note:** when the app is deployed by an administrators, the app will have permission to automatically review email and appointment recipient lists when sending emails or creating/modifying appointments. This allows support for key actions such as displaying a banner to add new contacts to the CRM system and updating the Copilot for Sales side panel with relevant CRM information for those contacts.

Discover more with these helpful links:

- [Explore what's possible with Copilot for Sales](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2259005)
- Check out our [FAQ](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/p/?linkid=2258498)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Search, connect, and update Dynamics 365 records in Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
Switching between business apps and collaboration apps to share data, documents, and records can impede the flow of work, slowing progress on activities ranging from sales deals to customer support cases. The Dynamics 365 app for Microsoft Teams extends the ability for anyone in an organization to view and collaborate on Dynamics 365 records from within Teams. 

 Features: 
� Share documents between a connected Microsoft Teams channel and your customer engagement apps record 
� Collaborate with other team members by adding a customer engagement app record or view as a tab to a channel in Microsoft Teams and adding recommended members 
� Chat with your team members side-by-side in the app tab 
� Search and share Dynamics 365 records as information cards in chats (production ready preview) 
� Update Dynamics 365 records from within chats (production ready preview)  
� Add chat messages to Dynamics 365 as notes or tasks (production ready preview) 
� View and update Dynamics 365 records before, during, and after meetings right from Teams (preview) 
� Notes and tasks added during meetings sync back to Dynamics 365 automatically (preview)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Monitor your Azure pipelines activity.
appDefinitions.description:
Use Azure Pipelines app to get real-time pipeline status updates, approval requests, and much more. Quickly search and share pipeline status with your colleagues directly in Microsoft Teams.
Features:- Subscribe to various pipeline notifications from any project or organization that you are part of.
- Approve or reject requests directly in Microsoft Teams.
- Search and share pipeline status with a few clicks.
- Use rich link previews for your pipelines in Teams chats.
Note: In order to use this app, users must have an active Azure DevOps account. For queries or feedback, refer to the documentation at Azure DevOps User Guide - Provide Feedback

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Sends notifications to Azure AD users on behalf of Azure AD services.
appDefinitions.description:
An Azure AD bot developed to facilitate communication between Azure AD services and their customers. When an Azure AD service needs to notify a customer, raise awareness or prompt action, this bot provides the ability to communicate said issue via Microsoft Teams. 
 BE ADVISED: Azure AD Notifications bot is an enterprise app that requires some configuration by your administrator. Azure AD Notifications only supports select Azure AD features & services

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Monitor pull request activity in your Azure Repos repository
appDefinitions.description:
The Azure Repos app for Microsoft Teams enhances your repository management by allowing you to monitor activities directly from your channel. Create subscriptions to receive notifications for code pushes, check-ins, pull request activities (creation, updates, merges), and more. Utilize the messaging extension to easily search and share pull requests with colleagues, fostering collaboration. Additionally, get pull request previews by simply sharing their URLs.
Features- Subscribe to notifications for repositories from any project or organization.
- Manage notifications and settings directly within Teams to suit your needs.
- Use the messaging extension to search and share pull requests.
- Benefit from URL unfurling for detailed pull request previews.
Note:In order to use this app, users must have an active Azure DevOps account. Users must have sufficient permissions and must be part of the organization to access the app functionality. Contact the organization admin for any concerns. For queries or feedback, refer to the documentation at Azure DevOps User Guide - Provide Feedback

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Build and organize your knowledge base of company resources
appDefinitions.description: Do you know that you can store all your company SOPs, tutorials, and user guides right inside Microsoft Teams? Perfect Wiki is an intuitive and detail-oriented knowledge database that lets you store and edit your SOPs, user guides, HR practices, onboarding flows, and more—right inside your Microsoft Teams/Outlook/Microsoft 365. Our mission is one of simplicity—we want you to have the versatility of a third party knowledge management tool, while sparing you the headache of switching between workspaces. Want to know if Perfect Wiki is right for your team? Want a personalized step-by-step tutorial on the features and installation process? [Book a live video consultation with us today!](https://perfectwiki.com/book/) Perfect Wiki works with Copilot for Microsoft 365. Example prompt: "Find Perfect Wiki pages that has 'onboarding' word".  Perfect Wiki uses AI to generate content, if you need more information about our AI model, come across any objectionable AI-generated content, or have any questions at all, please reach out to us at [hello@perfectwiki.com](mailto:hello@perfectwiki.com)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: The easiest way to manage employees' vacations, PTO, absences, and home office.
appDefinitions.description:
absentify is not just another time-off management tool; it's your all-in-one solution designed exclusively for the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Say goodbye to tedious, disorganized Excel sheets and hello to streamlined absence and remote work management.

🌟 **Key Benefits:**
- **Full Integration**: Seamlessly integrates with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365, consolidating all your absence and remote work data in one place.
- **Real-time Tracking**: Monitor absences, remote work, and approve time-off requests on the go, directly within your Microsoft Teams environment.
- **Enhanced Transparency**: Gain immediate insight into team availability, reducing conflicts and improving project planning.
- **High Security**: ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant, with all data securely stored in Microsoft Azure.
- **Comprehensive Management**: Ideal for tracking employee vacations, PTO, absences, remote work, and holiday management.

👉 **For New Users:**
- **Sign Up**: Easy onboarding—get started right within the app.
- **Get Started**: For administrators, visit our [Initial Setup Guide](https://support.absentify.com/en/category/initial-setup-xm2n61/). Employees can check the [Quickstart Guide](https://support.absentify.com/en/article/quickstart-guide-for-employees-j2r3gd/).
- **Contact Us**: Have questions or want to report objectionable content? [Email us or start a chat](https://support.absentify.com/en/) at the bottom of our support page.
- **Help**: Need technical support? Browse our [Support Page](https://support.absentify.com/en/).

Experience hassle-free, integrated absence and remote work management with absentify—the easiest and most efficient way to manage and approve vacation time, holidays, remote work, and more. Additionally, benefit from our AI Chatbot for natural language absence requests.

**Note:** The AI feature is not enabled by default and must be activated by an administrator. Data is only shared with AI upon the user's explicit consent and through an administrator. Please report any objectionable content promptly.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Share vital CRM records and stay updated on key sales metrics with Zoho CRM.
appDefinitions.description:
Zoho CRM is a cloud CRM software designed to help your organizations foster stronger relationships with customers. Manage your entire sales process from end to end with pipeline management, process automation, in-depth reporting, fine-tuned security settings and much more with Zoho CRM. Bring in leads, nurture them through your pipeline and convert them into happy paying customers.
**Zoho CRM Features:**
- Generate, nurture and convert leads to lifelong customers with an intuitive pipeline management system.

- Workflows and process automation tool to help automate tasks to allow sales people more time to focus on engaging customers.

- Access control, encryption and other security and privacy features protect customer data and ensure their privacy is maintained.

HROne is a global leader in cloud based HCM software, dedicated to revolutionizing HR processes and creating amazing workplaces. Unlock the true potential of HR professionals by automating mundane tasks and liberating their valuable time and mental space. 
 
 
HROne Bot service provide users an easy interface to request most common tasks:

1. **View Letters** - Access all letters given to an employee.
2. **View Payslips** - Review monthly payslips.
3. **Raise Tickets** - Submit a helpdesk request for the internal team.
4. **Mark Attendance** - Record daily attendance.
5. **Apply leave** - Request leave easily.
6. **Attendance Regularization** - If you forget to mark attendance, you can regularize it through RM.
 
In order to use this app. User must have an active HROne accounts, If your organization subscribed HROne services, please ask HR Team to enable HROne Bot service for Teams or write us at [connect@hrone.cloud](mailto:connect@hrone.cloud), or use our [Contact Us](https://hrone.cloud/contact/) page.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Sign documents or request signatures within Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
Extend your Microsoft Teams experience with Signeasy. Sign documents or request signatures directly from your Teams app. Go paperless and reduce costs, delight customers, and close deals faster.
 
[New] Signeasy for Microsoft Teams channel tab
Add Signeasy to any multi-user channel within Microsoft Teams and collaborate with your team members to get your internal documents reviewed and signed quickly.
 
Real-time bot notifications
Get real-time notifications about the status of their pending documents sent straight to their Teams app.
 
Key features:
[#LI] New! Use Signeasy from the same place you connect with your team – in channel conversations or the messaging area. Collaborate with your team members to get your internal documents reviewed and signed quickly within Microsoft Teams  [/#LI]
 
[#LI] Upload and sign documents of all formats like text, PDF, Word, Excel, JPG, PNG, and other popular document formats right from your personal app [/#LI]
[#LI] Add the date, your name, your initials, and other annotations to the document while signing [/#LI]
[#LI]Use the Request Signature option to send documents to others for signature: add recipients' email addresses, specify the signing order, and add a custom message [/#LI]
 
[#LI]Guide your signers through the document by adding fields that show each individual where to provide information [/#LI]
 
[#LI]Get visibility into your signature workflows with real-time chat notifications [/#LI]
 
Availability:
In order to use this app, users must have an active Signeasy account. Please visit our [Help Centre](https://support.signeasy.com/support/solutions/articles/5000778903-installing-the-signeasy-ms-teams-add-in)  or reach out to our [Support Team](https://support.signeasy.com/support/home) for more information. Your admin may have to enable the Signeasy app for your Microsoft Teams account.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Unleash the power of RPA by automating with UiPath
appDefinitions.description:
UiPath brings the power of API automation to its well reputed robotic process automation (RPA) software suite. Now, you can build seamless RPA workflows and automate across your organization with the help of API + UI automation.

UiPath Notifications allow users to receive notifications/updates from the automations built using UiPath platform capabilities by integrating any of the enterprise & productivity applications available in UiPath's Integration Service

You can seamlessly accomplish the below tasks by using the UiPath Notifications:
- Send text messages to channels on behalf of a user or bot
- Send adaptive cards to channels on behalf of a user or bot
- Read the info about the users, channels and your workspace etc.
For example, 
- When an opportunity is closed-won in a CRM tool, send a message to the Sales team channel for review and create Sales order in an ERP tool

Pre-requisites/Limitations:
- User must have a valid UiPath account in order to use this app
- Configure the respective notification settings in your UiPath account to receive system/account updates. Refer https://docs.uipath.com/automation-cloud/automation-cloud/latest/admin-guide/managing-notifications for more details
- This app/bot does not support prompts i.e. asking questions

For more details on Microsoft Teams in UiPath's Integration Service, refer https://docs.uipath.com/activities/other/latest/integration-service/uipath-microsoft-teams-about

For support or additional information, please reach us at https://www.uipath.com/support

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Allow employees to receive urgent, critical messages through Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
RedFlag Mass Notification integration with Microsoft Teams allows you leverage an additional way to send urgent and critical alerts to your organization.
When a message is sent from the RedFlag mass notification system, Microsoft Team users will receive a desktop notification and mobile app alert of a chat message, ensuring the message is communicated immediately. Also receive real-time intelligence and feedback by utilizing polling and confirming your recipients have read the messages.
RedFlag is an easy-to-use, multi-channel emergency mass notification system that allows you to deliver real-time alerts and critical information to groups of any size. Our award-winning alert software can be used by small businesses up to enterprise corporations to send mass alerts, gain visibility into events happening in the field, efficiently coordinate resources, and to make smart, data-informed decisions.  Learn more [here](https://pocketstop.com/).

A RedFlag account is required to complete this integration. For questions or assistance, you may contact us [here](https://pocketstop.com/request-a-demo/).
RedFlag is a product of Pocketstop LLC

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Search, share, preview Bigtincan content and receive notifications.
appDefinitions.description:
Bigtincan is a leading Sales Enablement provider that empowers customer-facing teams to prepare, engage, measure, and continually improve the buying experience.

With the Bigtincan app, you can:
• Search content from Bigtincan within Microsoft Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365
• Share content of your choice
• View content previews
• Receive notifications about activity on content shared
• Prepare for your meetings by adding content from Bigtincan
• Present content during the meeting
• Get answers from Genie in meetings

GenieAI is now available in meetings. Get answers to your questions along with content recommendations while preparing for your meetings and also during live meetings.

• search content related to Bigtincan XR in Bigtincan
• search files related to Bigtincan XR in Bigtincan, published after 2023-11-01

SearchAI is part of Bigtincan's GenieAI™ technology. To know more about GenieAI™ , please visit [Bigtincan GenieAI™](https://www.bigtincan.com/genie-ai/)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Communicate efficiently, manage your activities and network strategically

-Manage your contacts centrally in Teams. Whether you are using your company’s internal list of contacts, the ARGUS DATA INSIGHTS journalist database or your own contact database, manage, organise and make use of all your contacts directly in Teams!

-Centralise your communications activities and feedback. AUGURE offers you a centralised hub to neatly manage all your communications activities and receive direct feedback on your press releases.

-Communicate and collaborate easily. You can immediately see when a contact is available in Microsoft Teams and seamlessly interact with them, enabling you to communicate and collaborate more efficiently.

Customer administrators can seamlessly integrate AUGURE into Microsoft Teams. It is easy to set up using the Microsoft Teams Admin Center.

For new users interested in Augure for Microsoft Teams, a tailored way to explore its features and capabilities would be to [request a demo](https://outlook.office365.com/book/AUGUREVorstellung@ausschnitt.onmicrosoft.com/). Requirements: an active AUGURE account is **required** to make sure all functions are available in AUGURE for Teams.

Support and assistance: do you have any questions or you need some help? Visit our [support page](https://augure-teams.net/contact-us/) or reach out to us at [enquiries@augure.com](mailto:enquiries@augure.com?subject=Augure).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Start and join AnyMeeting video or audio conferences directly from Teams.
appDefinitions.description:
Intermedia Unite™ is a full-featured UCaaS solution that combines cloud PBX voice, chat, business SMS, video conferencing and file sharing into a single platform—simplifying how your teams communicate and work together. Unite’s easy to use desktop and mobile applications empower teams to stay connected no matter where they are, streamline workflows, and get more done.

Intermedia AnyMeeting, Unite’s video conferencing solution, is designed to help teams work better together. AnyMeeting’s built-in collaboration tools make it easy for participants to share content for more interactive and productive meetings in real-time.

The AnyMeeting for Teams bot increases productivity and streamlines workflows by saving users time from switching between applications while working in Teams. Users can seamlessly transition from Teams to AnyMeeing, where they can meet face-to-face, share their screens, and collaborate better together. Once the Bot is installed in a channel, users will be able to:

· Type “@AnyMeeting meet” to share meeting and audio conference details in Teams.

· Join any meeting or audio conference with just one click.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Connect your apps and automate workflows.

- Need more info? Check out the Zapier [website](https://zapier.com/apps/microsoft-teams/integrations/?utm_source=partner_msft-teams_integrations&utm_medium=embed_app_directory_listing&utm_campaign=partner_msft-teams).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Interactive Online Social Games: Transform Your Workday with Guul
appDefinitions.description:
Start your day with a cup of coffee, log into your virtual workspace, and instead of diving straight into emails, why not start with a little fun? Guul adds a touch of joy to your workday.
☀️A Morning of Focus
It’s 9 AM, and before your first meeting, you take a few minutes to play Find the Word. It’s a quick brain teaser that helps you wake up and get your mind in gear. By the time you’re done, you’re ready to tackle the day.
🔨❄️Breaking the Ice in Meetings
Your team has a new member joining today, so why not break the ice with a game during the meeting? With Guul, you can easily add a fun activity to make everyone feel welcome and relaxed.
⚽️Predict the Outcome
As you check your channels, you notice there’s a big Champions League match today. You hop into the Predictor Games channel to make your guess. It’s a fun way to add some excitement to your day and something to look forward to.
🥪Lunchtime Fun
Lunchtime rolls around, and you and a colleague can’t decide what to eat. Instead of debating, you settle it with a quick game of Rock Paper Scissors. It’s a lighthearted way to make decisions and adds a bit of fun to your break.
💪Afternoon Engagement
Later in the day, your team comes together for a project. To keep things lively, you suggest a round of Match & Pass. It’s a great way to connect with your colleagues and keep the energy up.
🛠️Managing the Fun
The Admin Panel is your go-to tool. You can set gaming hours, manage players, and track how much time your team spends on Guul. It’s all about finding the right balance between work and play.
🏆End the Day with a Smile
As the workday ends, you check the leaderboard. Whether you’re on top or not, the day feels fulfilling, filled with work and a bit of play. You log off, looking forward to tomorrow.

Why Guul?
Guul isn’t just for games—it’s for bringing teams closer together. Whether it’s a quick game to break the ice or a group challenge to build engagement, Guul makes every workday more vibrant and connected.
With Guul, you have access to a wide variety of games tailored to different moods and moments:
2-Player Games offer a perfect way to challenge a colleague in a strategic duel:
🎲 Backgammon, ♟️ Chess, 🏅 Checkers, ⚔️ Draughts, 🍀 Four in a Row, 🚀 Battleship, 💣 Minesweeper, 👀 Blob Wars, 9️⃣ Nine Men’s Morris
Group Games are ideal for getting everyone involved and fostering team spirit:
🔄Match & Pass, 🀄Okey/Rummikub
Predictor Games add an extra layer of excitement, letting you guess the outcomes of major events:
⚽ Football Events: Champions League, Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Ligue 1, and Bundesliga etc., Olympics 📽️ Oscars, 🎤 Eurovision Song Contest
Quick Games are perfect for those brief moments when you need a fun distraction or a quick decision-maker:
⭕ ❌ Tic-Tac-Toe, ✂️ Rock Paper Scissors, 🎲 Dice, 🪙 Heads & Tails
And the best part? Guul is FREE for up to 10 monthly active users per workspace. Need more? You can easily upgrade by contacting our support team at [support@guul.games](mailto:support@guul.games). If you encounter any objectionable content or discrepancies while using our app, please also report them directly to our support team by emailing [support@guul.games](mailto:support@guul.games). We are committed to ensuring a safe and enjoyable gaming experience for all users.
Watch our [video tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/embed/_VmIrSUnKaE?cc_load_policy=1&cc_lang_pref=en) on how to install Guul in your Microsoft Teams workspace for easy setup. 
Explore our [Help Center](https://help.guul.games/integrations-microsoft-teams) for tips and guides on using Guul: https://help.guul.games/
Bring the spirit of play to your workspace with Guul and transform your team's virtual experience today!

* Marketing teams to capture and nurture leads.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Gain insights, edit, convert, and collaborate on PDFs in Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
With Adobe Acrobat, you can now increase productivity with generative AI and collaborate on and make changes to your PDFs right from within Microsoft Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 (Office).
 For instance, the PDFs from your Microsoft Teams Chats, OneDrive etc. are now centrally available to open directly within the Teams environment to analyze and surface insights, and  make changes like organizing pages, compressing, converting to other formats, protecting, and more! You can collaborate with others in your Teams Channel and collect feedback in a single PDF so reviewers can see each other’s comments and it is easier to reconcile feedback and get things done. Notifications keep you informed when others take action on shared documents.
 Tenant admins can set Adobe Acrobat app as the default PDF viewer in Teams by setting a policy on Teams Admin Center to install the app on user's client. Instructions on how to do this are available [here](https://www.adobe.com/go/acroteams_fh_help).
**Free-to-use features:**
- High quality viewing — Acrobat lets you open high-fidelity PDFs directly within Microsoft Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 (Office), for a satisfying and seamless work experience.
- Streamline PDF review - Collect channel members’ feedback in a single PDF directly in Teams instead of gathering and reconciling feedback via multiple attachments. This feature requires users to have an Adobe account.*
- Keep reviewers informed — Reviewers get notified when others reply to their comments. 
- Secure collaboration — Collaborate securely with trusted members and retain the ability to store document versions in Microsoft SharePoint or OneDrive.**
**Premium features (require Acrobat subscription):**
- If you do not have an existing Acrobat subscription, subscribe now to unlock these features right within Acrobat in Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 (Office).
 - Convert PDFs to Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, or Image
 - Combine multiple documents and file types into one PDF file
 - Delete, rotate, extract, insert or reorder pages of a PDF
 - Reduce the size of your PDF for easier sharing
 - Add a password to protect your PDF.
**Acrobat AI Assistant features which requires [AI Assistant add-on]( https://www.adobe.com/acrobat/generative-ai-pdf.html#compare-plans):**
 AI Assistant for Adobe Acrobat is a conversational feature that lets you interact with your documents to get quick answers to questions based on your PDF   content in a comprehensive and informative way.
 - Insights you can trust – AI Assistant looks only at the documents you tell it to. And by generating verifiable insights with attributions back to the source, you can be assured you’re accessing credible information.
 - Writing made easy – Empower your team to rapidly create high-quality professional content for emails, blogs, presentations, research summaries, and more. Use the responses AI Assistant generated from your documents to get the write-up you need and produce your deliverables in less time.
 - Enhanced meeting transcript support – Whether you are leading a meeting, participating, or missed it altogether, enhanced meeting transcript support will help you stay in the know and turn meeting insights into takeaway actions. Automatically generate meeting summaries from transcripts to understand main topics, key points, and action items.
** Commenting currently is not supported on the mobile experience.
** Learn more about security for Acrobat [here](https://www.adobe.com/content/dam/cc/en/trust-center/ungated/whitepapers/doc-cloud/acrobat-dc-security-overview-ue.pdf).
** AI Assistant is currently available in English only.
 The app utilizes the 'onMessageAttachmentsChanged' launch event to improve email collaboration. Specifically, it detects when a PDF is attached to an email and prompts users to convert the PDF into a shareable Adobe Document Cloud public link.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Create dynamic Knowledge Graphs  that can infer
appDefinitions.description:
This app brings the power of ThinkBase here so you can create dynamic Knowledge graphs to encapsulate corporate knowledge and use bots to exploit them.

Unlike other bot frameworks, with ThinkBase, you describe the problem you are trying to solve graphically and using our Fuzzy-logic rule language.
ThinkBase then works out dependencies and the most important information to elicit first. It automatically creates a chat process for you, asking the user questions until the goal of the knowledge graph is satisfied.
Questions made irrelevant by previous answers are not asked.
ThinkBase makes it easy to create active Dynamic Knowledge Graphs that encapsulate your company's knowledge and can decide and predict on your behalf. Our graphical editor makes it simple to construct an outline knowledge graph, and our Fuzzy-logic inference language makes it simple to describe the mathematical or logical relationships between the members.
Being based on fuzzy logic, ThinkBase can infer and provide answers when only vague or incomplete information is present.

ThinkBase works with other ThinkBase apps and websites, such as https://ThinkBase.dev. Knowledge graphs can be created and tested with ThinkBase and then provided for general use within your company via other apps.

Read more about ThinkBase at https://thinkbase.support
Report any problems at: https://thinkbase.freshdesk.com.
In order to use this app, your organization needs to have an active “ThinkBase” license.

The conversation appears in a separate, dedicated card that contains all relevant information about the query in a structured workflow, separate from any other conversations in the same channel.

Messages are automatically exchanged back and forth while the conversation participants remain on different platforms. Finally, as the query is initiated in Taskize, all of the interactions are captured for Taskize auditing and reporting, allowing you to better understand your business and gather meaningful insights.

- Access: Configure multiple reports and share your access with multiple managers at no extra cost. Team members also get access to ScrumGenius dashboard and member settings. So they can customise their profile, notification settings and vacation settings.

appDefinitions.description:

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Quickly resolve IT issues and manage support tickets with EasyVista's agent
appDefinitions.description:
Enhance your IT support experience with **EasyVista**, a dedicated app developed for seamless integration within Microsoft Teams.
As a leading SaaS provider in IT service management solutions, EasyVista brings the power of ITSM directly to your team's workspace, making it easier for employees to resolve IT issues and stay informed without leaving Teams.
Designed for employees and IT support teams, this app empowers users with intuitive, conversational IT support to increase efficiency and improve satisfaction.

**Key Features**

- **Knowledge Base Search**: Effortlessly access relevant IT articles by querying your company knowledge base directly within Teams. Solve issues independently and reduce dependency on IT support by accessing self-service information anytime, anywhere.
- **Incident Creation**: Quickly report IT issues by creating new incident tickets through a simple chat interface. Users can provide incident details, categorize issues, and instantly submit reports to the IT team.
- **Incident Follow-up**: Stay updated on active tickets with easy, real-time follow-up capabilities. Simply ask the agent for status updates on your open incidents, eliminating the need to navigate to external platforms for tracking progress.

**Unique Value Proposition**

EasyVista is purpose-built to enhance the IT support experience **within Microsoft Teams** by providing immediate access to ITSM capabilities through a user-friendly conversational agent powered by generative artificial intelligence. By bridging IT support with daily collaboration, EasyVista helps teams save time, reduce support wait times, and increase overall productivity, all within a familiar, trusted platform.

**Scenarios and Use Cases**

- **Self-Service Support**: Users can independently resolve common IT issues by accessing the EasyVista knowledge base directly within Teams, improving user satisfaction and reducing pressure on IT support teams.
- **Efficient Incident Management**: Employees can instantly create and submit incident reports through a conversational interface, streamlining incident creation and tracking without requiring a separate platform.
- **Real-Time Updates**: Users receive prompt updates on their open tickets, keeping them informed and reducing the need to manually check the status of their support requests.

**Key Benefits**

1. **Improved User Satisfaction**: Empower employees with quick and convenient access to IT support within Microsoft Teams, allowing them to work more efficiently and receive faster resolutions to their issues.
2. **Increased Self-Service Resolution Rates**: Enhance self-sufficiency by allowing users to search for solutions in the knowledge base, decreasing support load on IT teams and accelerating issue resolution.
3. **Streamlined IT Workflow**: Reduce response times for IT incidents and create a seamless process for issue reporting and follow-up—all accessible within Microsoft Teams.

**Requirements**

To use EasyVista for Microsoft Teams:
- Your company must work with an EasyVista representative to link your Service Manager account to your Microsoft 365 tenant.
- Your company must grant the admin consent to the app to enable Microsoft Entra ID SSO.
- You need a valid EasyVista Service Manager user account to use the app's features.

**Getting started & support**

This app is available in the following languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.
For assistance or to learn more about EasyVista, please visit our [Support Page](https://www.easyvista.com/support) or [Request a Demo](https://www.easyvista.com/request-ev-demo) to discover what EasyVista can do for your company.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Be Hybrid, whether at office, remote or mobile share your location.
appDefinitions.description:
Be Hybrid, choose to work from office, remote or mobile, and see your colleagues work location.

With the Hybrid workplace now the new normal we find ourselves collaborating and working in new Spaces and Places. Some of these new places are completely virtual and other times we are returning to an office space which has been transformed to support our new ways of working.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Reliable and Powerful Calling, SMS, and fax for Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
AT&T Office@Hand for Microsoft Teams turbocharges your Teams deployment with a market-leading cloud business phone. Highly reliable telephony, advanced calling features, and market-leading analytics transform Teams into a powerful communications hub.

AT&T Office@Hand for Teams empowers users to:

- **Place and receive calls:** Embed AT&T Office@Hand’s telephony in Microsoft Teams to place and receive calls from both external and internal contacts.
- **Call history:** View call history including missed, received, and outbound calls. Manage your call history, call contacts, send an SMS or fax, add contacts to your directory, or block the number from an integrated view.
- **Voicemails:** Simplify workflows with quick actions to voicemail messages.
- **Send faxes and SMS messages:** Make Microsoft Teams a comprehensive communications platform with integrated fax and SMS message capabilities.
- **Unified contact list:** Integrated contact lists from Microsoft and AT&T Office@Hand make it simple to find and reach a contact.
- **Presence sync:** Help users avoid needless interruptions with automatic presence sync between Microsoft Teams and AT&T Office@Hand.
- **Enhanced user experience:** A modern and simplified user experience offers customization and personalized phone settings within Microsoft Teams.
- **Notifications:** Stay on top of any missed activity with push notifications.
- **Heads-up display:** View colleagues' real-time availability and manage multiple incoming calls within Microsoft Teams.
- **Analytics:** AT&T Office@Hand’s analytics empower you to build reports from templates, customize them for your needs, and share them with anyone.
- **Multi-device support:** Supports Teams desktop, web, and mobile platforms.
- **Dark mode:** Supports light and dark themes to switch between them as desired.
- **Simplified deployment and administration:** A simple three-step process pushes AT&T Office@Hand for Microsoft Teams to your entire organization or select users.

**Getting Started**

2. AT&T Office@Hand for Teams Desktop Plugin

For Microsoft Teams mobile:
1. AT&T Office@Hand for Teams
2. AT&T Office@Hand mobile app

Currently Bahrain, China, Cuba, Egypt, India, Indonesia, Iran, Kenya, Kuwait, Mexico, Morocco, North Korea, Pakistan, Philippines, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Sudan, Syria, Taiwan, Thailand, Turkey, United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam are the countries/regions that block VoIP calls.

New to AT&T Office@Hand? Sign up [here ↗](https://www.business.att.com/products/office-at-hand.html)

**System requirements**

- Supports Teams desktop, web, and mobile platforms.
- Available for all AT&T Office@Hand MVP™ subscriptions.
- An active Microsoft 365 account is required.
- Windows 7 and above or Mac OS X 10.10 (or later) is required.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Find the information you need across work apps without leaving Microsoft Teams.
appDefinitions.description:
Albus is a universal search tool that integrates with your workplace apps to deliver instant and accurate answers. 

When you ask a question, Albus analyzes all your connected sources and provides you with accurate answers. No more switching between apps. With Albus, everything you need is one message away.

**Key Features:**

🚀 One click integration with 25+ workplace applications. No more juggling between platforms anymore and easily streamline information from multiple sources.

😎 No specific data formatting requirement. Whether it's a quick note in Notion or a detailed article in Confluence, Albus makes sense of it all.

🤫 Albus is permissions-aware and understands every employee’s access to data. He shares information to employees based on their access to the data in its origin source. You can create wikis for different groups of employees to maintain data privacy among different teams.

**Used Across teams:**

🎫 Customer Success: Instantly address complex customer queries, eliminating the need to wait for the engineering team or jumping between multiple resources.

🖥️ HR Employee Helpdesk: Albus tackles repetitive HR questions around leaves, allowance, credentials - allowing the HR team to focus on strategic tasks rather than routine questions.

📚 Product Management: No more hopping between Jira, Slack, and PRDs to track progress. Albus brings everything right inside Microsoft Teams.

🗒️ Sales and Marketing: Find and leverage marketing resources and collateral in seconds without getting lost.

**Security:**

🔐 We prioritize data security at every step. Albus is SOC Type 2 certified, ISO 27001 & ISO 27701 certified and GDPR compliant. 

**Let us talk about technology:**

Behind the scenes, Albus is powered by GPT-4 and Cohere, two of the most advanced AI technologies available today. Additionally, Albus utilizes Microsoft Azure OpenAI to extract information from documents and applications that you connect. This makes Albus incredibly accurate, fast, and easy to use along with human-like comprehension skills.

It’s time to unify all your workplace apps and get information at your team’s fingertips **because people don’t actually want to search - they just want the answer!**

**Getting started:**

Install Albus on Microsoft Teams and sign up with an account on the dashboard for free. The free-forever plan covers core features with a limit of 50 questions/month for the entire team. 

Learn more about Albus [here](https://www.springworks.in/albus/).

If you prefer talking to someone, get in touch with us over [chat](https://www.springworks.in/albus) or drop us an [email](mailto:albus@springworks.in).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: We Decide helps organizations to make faster decisions within Microsoft Teams.
appDefinitions.description:
Less meetings and more decisions! WeDecide provides organizations a simple and structured way to create and collaborate on team decisions in Microsoft Teams by introducing decision cards. Decision cards help moving decisions out of conference calls and remove the need to email back and forth on team decisions. 

 

    Increase team engagement and never again miss a decision deadline. You can use WeDecide for example to decide on budget plans, dinner plans or new hires. Your decision data does not leave your company: all the relevant data gets saved inside your companies SharePoint, so you don’t have to worry about sensitive data.
    
     
    
    Easily create decision cards:
    One team member creates a decision card by entering title, a description and implications for both approval and rejection. To provide additional information users can add document attachments like PDF, Word or Excel to guide the decision voters in making their vote. After creation, a bot informs users about the new decision and reminds them of deadlines, so decision making get accelerated.
    
     
    
    Decide within your team:
    After installation, WeDecide gets added to a team as it's own tab. Decision cards can be create from here. You can delete old decisions or update their status to prevent users to vote on an already resolved decisions. After you created a decision the WeDecide chatbot pushes a notification to all respective voters, that a new decision has been created. The information provides them with a link so that the decision card can be reviewed inside MS Teams. Once a voter decided, the decision creator gets a notification from the chatbot telling him that someone voted on his decision. After a voter has decided, he will see the other votes underneath his vote within the decision card. This makes it easy to understand who has voted. It is only displayed after voting, so no one gets influenced in decisions from other voters.

1. Send simple, easy to understand, unobtrusive engagement questions to team members.
2. Collect engagement levels, anonymously, from team members via emoji.
Turn these engagement levels into high granularity statistics for your organization.
3.Provide analytics to you, the leader, highlighting problem areas within your organization.

HappyTeams helps team members by allowing them to anonymously communicate their issues in an organization with their leaders. ⚙ Micro tools build a bridge between data sources and work management systems for business users. In this way, they provide a new way to make better decisions faster, and thus better results in a more efficient way. They connect to data sources with connectors and extend to work management systems with plugins. Therefore, business users can fetch their data quickly and turn it into a tool to make decisions faster and take actions through their work management systems via plugins.

💻 Another important characteristic of Deventral is providing all its functionality through an application specifically developed for the most used communication and collaboration tool, Microsoft Teams. The application also supports Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Outlook. In this way, users can use Deventral without going to any other software, just in their favourite collaboration tool in an embedded way.

You need to confirm the identity of your interlocutor? Nothing easier. You will verify it based on identity documents from 200 countries around the world and facial biometrics. You want to verify the identity of many people? No problem, all people will do it in a few moments, and only the host will see personal data.

Just confirming your identity is not enough and you need to sign the document electronically?

You can do this within teams or send a link from Inperly to any email address. The user will be able to:
- read the contract
- if he or she has a long-term qualified signature, sign the document (works with mSzafir, SimplySign, eDO App)
- If he or she does not have an electronic signature, we will issue it on the fly based on identity document and facial biometrics, or by confirming his identity in electronic banking.

The signed document will automatically return to the sender and the signer.

If you want to sign the document yourself, you can do it in several ways
- from the Teams channel
- from files
- from the dashboard

Thanks to the dashboard, you can view the statistics of signed files, or verify whether the sent document is already signed.

We currently work with the following providers:
- IDnow (identity verification, issuing a qualified signature and signing)
- eDO App (identity verification and advanced or qualified signature)
- mSzafir (issue of a qualified signature and signing)
- SimplySign (qualified signature signing)

For more information, please visit www.inperly.com

Assist is purpose-built for any organization that gets work done in Microsoft Teams, whether you’re in IT, HR, sales ops, customer success, DevOps, facilities, or another service team. appDefinitions.shortDescription: Get updates from your GitHub Enterprise Cloud (GHEC) instance on Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description: This application requires a GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHEC) instance: https://github.com/enterprise/contact/data-residency. Bring your code to the conversations you care about with the GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency app for Microsoft Teams. With two of your most important workspaces connected, you’ll get updates about what’s happening on your `*.ghe.com` instance—without leaving Microsoft Teams. Subscribe to repositories Use `@GHEC subscribe [owner/repo]` in Microsoft Teams to start receiving updates about that project. Stay up to date Get updates about what’s happening with your repositories in Microsoft Teams discussions for activities like: • New commits • New pull requests • New issues • Code reviews See the details Give your team more information in Microsoft Teams when you share links to GitHub activities and properties like: • Pull requests • Issues • Linked comments • Code snippets • Developer profiles Take actions with slash commands Microsoft Teams conversations often lead to decisions and actionable takeaways. Now it’s easier to start on next steps from Microsoft Teams with slash commands for common GitHub actions, using `@GHEC [action] [resource]`. For example, these commands let you: • Close an issue or pull request • Reopen an issue or pull request • Open a new issue using a Microsoft Teams dialog. Reach out for support at https://docs.github.com/en/support/contacting-github-support.

The Microsoft Teams app can be activated straight from the Marketplace inside the Personio settings – just click the "Connect Microsoft Teams" Button and follow the steps described. After you have inserted your Personio API credentials, you can configure the integration to your specific needs.

Here's what the Personio Microsoft Teams app allows you to do:

- **Daily update**

To ensure that the update is relevant for members of each channel, the message can be sent to multiple channels and filtered by team, department and office.

- **Absence requests**

Afterwards, you'll be able to select the absence type, duration and submit the request. Your approver will be notified just as if you made the request directly in Personio.

You will need an active Personio account to use this app. Please contact our [support](https://www.personio.com/faq/service-support/) team for more details.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Remind yourself of posts or messages at a future time!
appDefinitions.description:
Ever find yourself wanting to remind yourself about a message, or just a simple to-do with no fuss? Well, **RemindMyself** is a bot and messaging extension that lets you remind yourself of posts at a future time. It helps your remember and follow up on short tasks, you just type your command _in plain English_! No need to load up your task or calendar app - everything is doable inside Teams!

You can tell **RemindMyself** to set reminders.  To set a reminder, just give **RemindMyself** a time and an optional message. For example:
* "4pm" -> This will set a reminder for 4pm
* "in 3 minutes call my boss" -> Reminder in 3 minutes
* "do my taxes tomorrow evening" -> Reminder tomorrow evening
* "April 1, send out the joke email" -> Reminder on April 1
* "Thursday night do my performance review" -> Perf review Thursday night :)

When the reminder fires, you will get a message from the bot.  You can read it, jump to the linked message, or snooze it!

Some features:
* You can type your command in the command box at the top of Teams
* You can converse with the bot directly to manage reminders
* You can @mention the bot in a channel (be a little passive aggressive :) ).
* You can set a "Quick Reminder" from a message context menu!

All reminders fire for you privately. **RemindMyself** will not send any messages to any channels or anyone else. Although here's a special bonus:
* if you @mention a person in a message to this bot, they will also get the reminder (this only works in channels or group chats)

This way you can remind both yourself and a colleague of important tasks.

Use **RemindMyself** to manage your personal and professional life, all from Teams itself!

appDefinitions.shortDescription: BrainBot sends short, scheduled interactions to help retain and learn knowledge
appDefinitions.description:
Did you ever take a class, and discover later that you can’t remember anything you learned?

It’s called the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve: we naturally forget most of the new information we learn within a few days and weeks - if we don’t use it.

BrainBot's unique chatbot solution fixes your “forgetting curve” with systematic and meaningful reinforcement boosts – a technique called Spaced Learning or Spaced Practice which has been shown to improve long-term memory and knowledge retention. Starting a day or two after you complete an eLearning course or training class, BrainBot will send short interactions via Microsoft Teams or Email. Each interaction may consist of a question (multiple choice or text), a poll, a video, or another resource link designed to help you retain and even expand upon the information you learned.

Trainers can setup BrainBot to interact with learners on a specifically designed schedule, to maximize the effectiveness of each boost. It doesn’t take much - a typical boost sequence may include 6 to 9 interactions over a 30 to 90 day period.

Best of all, BrainBot is uniquely designed to talk to each learner in the environments they already use every day: Microsoft Teams or Email. Many similar “booster” tools require users to use a proprietary app, and can only ask simple multiple choice questions.

BrainBot’s can ask more thoughtful questions that use text, video, interactive polls, and more, to fully engage the learner’s brain and lead to greater knowledge retention.

BrainBot was created by Bigger Brains, a premium online training company with hundreds of Microsoft and Business Skills courses. Many BrainBot boosters are available for Bigger Brains courses, and can be easily copied and customized to use with your own content.

Brainbot can also be used to deliver Assessments, Lessons, feedback surveys, and more.

Build your own BrainBot content by signing up for a Creator account at [https://brainbot.ai](https://brainbot.ai).

In order to use the app user needs to have an Active BrainBot account. You can create an account at [https://brainbot.ai](https://brainbot.ai)

Start your Easy Call Report journey today with a free, no-commitment trial — just install the app, purchase a license and cancel it any time, if your are not satisfied. More information about Easy Call Report can be found on our [website](https://twincapfirst.ch/teams-easy-call-report-en/).

appDefinitions.description:
Search for and retrieve Student records in Microsoft Teams chat using SEAtS. Students, faculty, and advisors, once logged in through Single Sign On, can quickly check on a student’s engagement and attendance levels.
Key Benefits
•	Real-time student success information
•	Designed for blended learning
•	Monitor student attendance data
•	Gain visibility over student engagement levels
•	Identify struggling or at-risk students early
•	Make data driven student case management decisions 
•	Students can see their own academic progress and statistics
 
Features
View a list of supported commands to be sent as a text message in your SEAtS chat, which will return the following student progression data: 
Student summary data
When a staff user posts a message to the SEAtS chat containing the students number and supported command (Student [StudentNumber] or Student [StudentNumber] Info), SEAtS will return an adaptive card containing a summary of information about the student, i.e. Full Name and student number [hyperlinked to SEAtS student details]; student type; email; list of courses;  last physical swipe;  last online, attendance and workflow stages info for the last 7 days. 
Student attendance data
When a staff user posts a message to SEAtS containing the students number and supported command (Student [StudentNumber] Attendance), SEAtS will return an adaptive card containing a summary of information about the student, i.e. Full name and student number; student type; email; list of active modules;  list last e.g. 10 student schedules with the following data: 
•	red/green up/down check icon corresponding to attendance/absence. 
•	timestamp in format x hours/days/etc ago 
•	lesson type 
•	attendance status 
•	7-day attendance 
Student case history
When a staff user posts a message to SEAtS containing the students number and supported command (Student [StudentNumber] Stages), SEAtS will return information about the student’s case history, ie. Full Name and student number [hyperlinked to SEAtS student details]; student type; email;  list of active workflows;  list of last 10 stage changes with the following data: 
•	red/green up/down arrow icon corresponding to stage move. Green down arrow when stages are equal. 
•	timestamp in format x hours/days/etc ago 
•	stage from 
•	stage to 
List of supported commands
When a staff user posts a message to SEAtS that does not contain a recognised command, SEAtS will return a list of supported commands.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Genea helps you manage your office's physical security from anywhere anytime.

Genea access control is a cloud-based software that interfaces with physical access control hardware, allowing customers to remotely program, operate, and oversee their property's physical access control system. Genea access control is engineered for building management teams and designed for the convenience of busy companies.
Genea integrates with Microsoft Teams to act as a physical security incident management platform. Access control hardware must be installed in order for customers to make use of the Microsoft Teams integration. When the hardware detects certain events occurring on a property, it is logged in the Genea software and if the event meets certain criteria, it will send a notification to the customer via Microsoft Teams.
Here’s how Genea + Microsoft Teams integration can keep your physical security operation running smoothly: 

1. Audit Log Notifications – Genea can notify you via Microsoft Teams when changes are made to your access system, including when users are created or deactivated, keys are issued or revoked, or changes are made to schedules or door groups, etc.
2. Access Control Notifications – Genea can notify you via Microsoft Teams when important events occur on your property such as Card Access Denied, Controller Offline issues, AC Power Failure, Battery Backup Failure, Held Open Alarms, Door Forced Alarms, etc.
3. Visitor Log Notifications – Genea can notify you via Microsoft Teams when visitors check in at your property
Benefits :

1. Reduces the amount of time your team spends monitoring video feeds and sifting through access logs.
2. Get notified instantly when security events occur so you can take action immediately, rather than pour through logs to find out what happened after the fact.
3. Show auditors that your lean team has everything under control and reduce those precious billable hours during an compliance audit.

Visit us at https://www.getgenea.com.
Contact Support at acsupport@getgenea.com or you can get started by requesting a demo at https://www.getgenea.com/landings/demo-request

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Your customer support team's AI assistant, trained on all your help docs.
appDefinitions.description:
My AskAI is your support team's own AI assistant, giving them instant, accurate, answers to questions about your business or product, trained on all your company’s knowledge base and website.

You can use My AskAI within Teams as an individual, to privately get answers to your questions. Or you can collaborate within a channel and get answers to questions so the rest of your team can see them as well.

To use this app, you must have an active account with My AskAI. Please sign up following the steps below.

-------

To get started:

1. Please go to https://myaskai.com/ to create your account and add your content (<10 mins)

2. Within your My AskAI dashboard, open 'Chatbot setup > Integrations' and click on the Team logo to get your AI assistant's ID and API Key

3. Install My AskAI within your Teams workspace/account (as an admin)

4. Within Teams, select the 'Connect My AskAI' button and input your ID and API Key

-------

How do I ask a question within Teams?

To ask questions (or follow up questions) to your AskAI within Teams, simply add My AskAI to a channel and then @My AskAI followed by your question.

Or you can start a new Chat with My AskAI and ask a question privately.

For example, if you'd uploaded documents about your onboaring process, you might ask: '@My AskAI what's our onboarding process?'

All responses are generated by AI. Please email team@myaskai.com to report inappropriate content.

-------

How to add or manage content for my AI assistant?

Content can only be added on https://myaskai.com/ within your account.

-------

What type of content can I add to My AskAI?

Within My AskAI, you'll be able to add your entire company website, connect your knowledge base sources or upload files directly.

-------

Can I use my AI assistant outside of Teams?

Yes, you can supercharge your customer support by adding your AI assistant to your site, as well as Teams, to answer customer questions directly. This must be setup and managed within your My AskAI dashboard.

-------

How do I disconnect my AI assistant from Teams?

Please type @My AskAI and select 'Disconnect'

appDefinitions.shortDescription: 新しいAIキャラクターをMicrosoft Teamsに入れることで、チームの透明性を高め、コミュニケーションを効率化・高品質化することができます。
appDefinitions.description:
Coordiruはメンバー間の繋がりをコーディネートし、社内コミュニケーションを加速するAIキャラクターです。マネジメントの負担や、HRの負荷を大きく軽減することができます。  
具体的には下記のような機能が実装されており、個別にオン・オフの設定も可能です。
- 呼び出し  
  自身が参加していないスレッドで、事前に登録しておいたキーワードが登場すると、メンションとDMで呼び出しをしてくれる機能です。これにより情報へのアクセスコストが減らせるだけでなく、チームメンバーが何に興味があるかがわかることで、今後のコミュニケーションに際して、そのメンバーを会話に最初から追加するなどの対応ができるようになります。
- トレンドウォッチャー  
  所定の期間（例えば、1週間など）の間に、Coordiruが参加しているチームで多く登場したキーワードをランキング形式で集計することが可能です。
- 画伯  
  AIによる自動生成の絵を作成することができます。これにより、アイディエーションに際して、意見がより出やすい環境を作ることなどもできます。
- 雑談  
  DMで直接Coordiruと会話をすることができます。雑談の応答は、最先端のAI会話生成モデルにより作成されており、感情を持っているかのような自然な会話を楽しむことができます。
- 隠れ蓑  
  ユーザーがCoordiruとして発話をすることができます。これにより、例えば経費精算のリマインドなど、人が行うと少しストレスを感じるような連絡でも、キャラクターから行うことで、ポストをする人も読む人も、ストレスが軽減されます。
- 翻訳  
  自動で入力された言語を識別し、事前に設定しておいた言語に翻訳ができます。例えば、事前に英語・中国語・日本語を登録していた場合、日本語で入力されたポストを、自動的に英語と中国語に翻訳を行ってくれます。  
  なお翻訳にあたっては、外部サービスであるDeepLを使用しています。

またチームごとに個別にCoordiruを導入することができるため、例えば機密情報などを扱うチームなどにはCoordiruを入れないように設定することも可能です。

**Features of Indie Microsoft Teams notification bot**

- Receives messages containing tips from the Indie Enterprise App and notifies the user in Microsoft Teams chat.
**Conditions of use**

- Your workplace admin needs to install the Indie Enterprise App and enable access to the Indie Microsoft Teams App for users. Instructions for Admins found [here](https://pioneera.com/faq?openTab=tab-5&openFeild=Admin+guide).

Indie uses 7 days of the users historic messages to help speed this up, but you shouldn't expect to receive nudges until after 2 weeks.  This can be reduced in time by special request to support.

This is a notification only bot, you can’t interact with it.
Any issues or questions [Contact Support](https://pioneera.com/contact-us).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: The HR assistant that engages and retains talent.
appDefinitions.description:
In the rapidly evolving business landscape, the role of Human Resources (HR) has undergone a significant transformation. From being a department that primarily dealt with administrative tasks, HR has evolved into a strategic partner that plays a crucial role in an organization’s success. One of the key responsibilities of HR today is to engage and retain talent, a task that is increasingly challenging in a world where job opportunities are abundant and employee expectations are high. To meet these challenges, many organizations are turning to technology for assistance. One such technological innovation is Nancy, a chatbot designed to serve as an HR assistant.
Nancy is not just a chatbot; Nancy is a revolutionary HR assistant designed to transform the way organizations manage their human resources. Nancy is built with the primary goal of enhancing employee engagement and retention, two factors that are critical to an organization’s success.
Engagement is about ensuring that employees are committed to their organization’s goals and values, are motivated to contribute to organizational success, and have an enhanced sense of their own well-being. Retention, on the other hand, is about keeping talented employees from leaving the organization. Both these factors are interrelated - engaged employees are more likely to stay with the organization, and retaining talented employees is easier when they are engaged.
With advanced capabilities, Nancy is designed to foster both engagement and retention. Nancy does this by focusing on several key areas:
1. Feedback and Recognition: Nancy is programmed to collect feedback from employees about their work experience, challenges, and suggestions. Nancy also recognizes employees for their achievements and contributions, which boosts morale and engagement.
2. Predictive Analytics: Nancy uses data analytics to identify early signs of employee dissatisfaction and potential turnover. This allows managers to proactively address concerns and provide solutions, thereby improving retention.
3. Onboarding and Offboarding: Nancy assists in the onboarding process of new hires, making them feel welcomed and valued. Nancy also manages the offboarding process, ensuring it is smooth and respectful.
In essence, Nancy is a comprehensive HR assistant that uses technology to enhance the human aspect of HR. Nancy is a companion on your journey to creating a thriving work environment, promising an engaged, motivated, and loyal workforce. By fostering a positive work environment, aligning company goals with employee aspirations, and nurturing personal and professional development, Nancy contributes to a productive and harmonious workspace.
Nancy also understands the unique nature of each organization and its HR processes. Surveys are sent to employees based on a personalised milestone like birthday, work anniversary, role change and as agreed upon by your HR department or company, ensuring that feedback and insights are timely and relevant.
Nancy's services are primarily designed for active users who will receive our various surveys. If a user or email isn't active, they should contact their HR department or reach out to rohit@myfuturely.com for support. For the additional assistance refer to https://www.mywelly.com/support/ 
In conclusion, Nancy is the future of human resource management. Nancy is a testament to how technology, when used effectively, can revolutionize traditional processes and create a more engaged and productive workforce. With Nancy, organizations can look forward to a future where managing human resources is not just about administrative tasks but about creating a work environment where every employee feels valued and motivated to contribute to the organization’s success.
Nancy is here to make your HR processes more efficient, your workforce more engaged, and your organization more successful. Welcome to the future of HR management, with Nancy.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Streamline and speed up incident resolution with AI-powered visual fishbone maps

What is smartQED?
smartQED is an intelligent visual workspace to help operations & support teams solve incidents and problems faster, with integrated recommendations and insights from prior issues. 

Get clear visibility into complex investigations, track status efficiently, get cause and solution suggestions from our AI-based recommendation engine(insight), and generate reports in real time with a single click!


Benefits of smartQED

smartQED speeds up your incident and problem resolution times significantly and increases the productivity of your teams. Here’s how it works:

Methodical Cause Analysis: Use structured fishbone-based Investigation Maps to visualize and explore in depth the potential causes of a problem. Our layered visual approach scales easily to complex issues and large teams.

Efficient Collaboration: Entire teams can jointly analyze problems with data organized in context in a 360° view. Get your teams on the same page by easily tracking causes and their statuses, deadlines, and relevant findings.

Automated Real-time Reporting: Provide better visibility into the investigation progress with summary or detailed reports to managers, customers and other stakeholders. Manually generate reports with one click, or auto-email them on a periodic basis.

Artificial Intelligence: Powerful AI capability in smartQED analyzes historical data of solved problems to generate cause & solution recommendations for your new issues. These AI-powered insights reduce or eliminate tedious manual searches to slash training times of new staff.

Easy Knowledge Capture and Reuse: Create and reuse QED templates to standardize the analysis approach and jumpstart future investigations. The mix-and-match capability of QED templates enables you to perform more complex analysis easily.

smartQED's innovative visual solution applies to problem and incident investigations as well as root cause analysis in any domain including:

🗸 IT Operations & Site Reliability Engineering
🗸 DevOps
🗸 Service Providers
🗸 Financial Systems
🗸 Healthcare
🗸 Transportation
🗸 Automotive, Aerospace & more. 
Turbocharge your problem resolution process with the combined power of smartQED and Microsoft Teams collaboration! Increase the quality and reliability of your products and services, boost your customer satisfaction, and obtain higher efficiency and team productivity.

smartQED Bot

Leverage the power of QED Investigation Maps without leaving your Microsoft Teams channel. Using easy-to-use buttons and commands, you can quickly build up the visual map of your issue while working in Microsoft Teams.

You can add causes to the investigation map, attach notes, clues, and actions, check the status, and even generate and download real-time summary and detailed Excel reports – all within a Teams channel!

Operations supported by the smartQED Bot 

Invoke the smartQED Bot by typing "@smartQED" in "New conversation", or by using the Messaging Extension within Teams. You will get a menu of operations to set the context information (connect the channel to an application and problem in smartQED), and view and update the investigation map for that problem. You can add causes, clues (relevant symptoms), assignees, actions, due dates and other relevant information.For example:

@smartQED ➡️ Menu ➡️ Cause [UPDATE] ➡️ Add (adds a new cause)

@smartQED ➡️ Menu ➡️ Action [UPDATE] ➡️ Add ➡️ Add an action to a cause 
[click here↗](https://community.smartqed.ai/knowledge-base/?top-category=ms-teams-app) to see the entire list of operations.

In order to use this app, your organization needs to have an active account on smartQED, [click here↗](https://app.smartqed.ai) to sign up for an account with 30-days free trial.

- Create **studyplans, lessonplans and curriculums** with learning outcomes and content.
- **Embed interactive content**, such as videos, Forms, Sways, documents and much more, to inspire learning and keep students engaged.
