With Haldor Education you get simple, yet powerful tools for your school, that have been developed for all scenarios: learning in school, remote learning and even hybrid learning. Educators and student can work fully in Microsoft Teams, giving them a dynamic learning environment where they can achieve their learning goals with ease, no matter where they are.
**Formative assessment made easy**
Haldor Education makes formative assessment easier by letting teachers break down and clarify learning goals, so that students understand what they are expected to learn. Teachers can give continuous feedback on assignments and plans, helping students to make progress in learning.
At the same time, teachers receive regular feedback from the students and can adapt teaching according to students’ needs. The students become more involved in their own learning and the teachers have a good basis on which to make assessments.
**Want to get started?**

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Protect your eyes from digital screens and visual fatigue

Protect your eyes while using digital screens, to prevent eye strain and visual fatigue

We spend so much time in front of digital screens and it is not healthy at all for our eyes. 75% of adults suffer from digital eye strain, which results in varying numbers and degrees of visual disorders (headaches, eye dryness, visual tingling, watery eyes, ...). Vizygood is a coach that will show you how to train your eyes to avoid visual fatigue or to reduce the impact of digital exposure for your eyes. Based on our expertise in preventive orthoptics, our eye exercise programs will allow you to *gain efficiency, concentration and visual comfort* without leaving the Microsoft Teams environment.

Main features:

A short questionnaire will enable Vizygood to calculate your Visual Vitality Index that indicates as well your level of visual fatigability.
A personalized daily program based on your visual vitality index will offer you a large range of short tone, relax and concentration workouts. The eye fitness workouts are very short (less than 1 minute), do not require any material nor assistance, except the video tutorials from your coach Vizygood!
Vizygood will encourage you to have micro-visual breaks in order to increase your concentration capabilities and to learn to disconnect from your screen.
You will also be able to test your ergonomics with your camera and to adjust your position in front of your screen. Personalized ergonomics tips will enable you to improve your working environment.
As you train your eyes and get new healthy habits for your eyes, you get higher scores and achieve upper levels of difficulty.

Vizygood helps you to have a responsible use of digital screens, to keep your eyes healthy.

Vizygood is a preventive tool but is not a medical device and does not provide any medical diagnosis.

https://coachforeyes.fr/en/contact-form

appDefinitions.description:
**How well do you know your colleagues?**

How many of them are enjoying their job, are afraid to look dumb in front of their team, think their manager is open to complaints or plan on leaving your company within 6 months?

**You cannot take good decisions when you don’t _really_ know what people think.**

VoxCollector allows you to engage all your employees in a daily poll based on anonymity (we don’t know who says what; which is the only way to get true insights in an environment with subordination) and transparency (we display the global results to all the coworkers). 

**How?**

Everyday, your employees will get a question in their Microsoft Teams channel. The questions are fun, short and impactful. Your colleagues will give their insights in total anonymity by pushing a button (agree or disagree). The next day, they will get the results and see what everybody thinks about yesterday's topic in total transparency. The questions have been designed with the help of the University of Leuven (Belgium) and allow us to benchmark your corporate culture after 3 to 6 months. 

**Why?**

First, to collect the opinions of your people on various topics and analyse them in the Vox platform that will display in real-time your company culture. Our academically backed framework measures 16 HR variables (Leadership quality, Autonomy, Vertical Communication, Social Support, etc.) and compares them to a benchmark: in the blink of an eye, you can see where you are and where you want to go. You can also track the evolution of each specific variable. 

Do you want to ask your own questions? You can schedule them, the same way you would with our specific questions. Or you can ask them via a pulse of multiple questions in a row. You can even request questions from your people which they can upvote or downvote. By doing so, you get to know their principal concerns.

Second, we can help you create change by “nudging” your people with some questions that address specific behaviours. (E.g. improve the meeting process, improve the respect at your workplace,…)

Third, in the Vox platform, you can generate monthly reports in the form of infographics with the major results and share them with your colleagues. Next to the reports and the various analyses, you will find articles specific to your situation to help you improve your weaknesses.

**How much does it cost?**

We don't do free trials but we have a fair pricing. You need a valid VoxCollector account in order to use the VoxCollector app. More info can be found by visiting [our website](https://start.voxcollector.com/4).  


**Why Vox and not the other classic polling tools?**

- We don’t do “classic” questions
- We are anonymous by design (we cannot find out on our servers what you or your colleagues voted, we just don't store this information)
- Our methodology is crafted with love and science, we have been elected best Belgian HR startup in 2018
- The setup is instant
- We don’t disrupt your colleague’s workday
- You get actionable insights that you would never get elsewhere
- Our solution is adapted for every team or company and can be expanded easily.

We are also human and if you want to have more info, don't hesitate to book a demo with us [here](https://calendly.com/matt-voxcollector/30mins).

The VoxCollector team.

**FAQ :**
1. As an admin, may I know who voted on a particular topic? No. We don’t store names and cannot link the answers to people. The finest granularity is at the Microsoft Teams channel level. If you want to poll different populations, separate them in different Microsoft Teams channels and you will get separate results for each channel.
2. Do you have a guide to ask good questions? Yes, we do, in the "Advice" section of the platform.

Your team and people can expect to receive coaching on communication, leadership development, management, and better teamwork. This coaching can be on your manager, coworkers, or even yourself.

- **Meeting Side Panel**: Add Happy to your meeting and receive communication advice and insights of participants based on their Happy Workstyle.

- **Specific Coaching**: With the `coach-select` command, get advice on how to effectively interact and collaborate with specific coworkers, building stronger, more productive working relationships.
- **Workstyle**: With the `workstyle` command, get the Happy Workstyle of a specific coworker to unlock powerful insights on how to communicate and collaborate more effectively.
- **Help Command**: Unsure of available commands? Use the `help` command to get a comprehensive list of all commands and their functions.

## How It Works

During a meeting in Meet, simply click the Apps button in the top navbar and select Happy Companies. Any participant in the meeting in a Happy Companies workspace will appear in the side panel when Happy Companies is selected. Click on a participant to view communication advice and insights based on their Happy Workstyle.

The Happy Companies bot proactively sends daily coaching tips and advice, ensuring you stay on top of your communication and personal development without disrupting your workflow.

## Why Choose Happy Companies?

- **Personalized Guidance**: Receive coaching tailored to your unique work style.
- **Improved Productivity**: Implement practical tips and strategies to enhance your efficiency and effectiveness at work.
- **Better Collaboration**: Learn how to better engage with your team members, fostering a more harmonious and productive work environment.

Visit Happy Companies to learn how Happy transforms people and teams.

For support, please visit our [help page](https://help.happycompanies.com/).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Beep offers clinicians a better alternative to pagers and bleeps
appDefinitions.description:
Beep provides a better experience than pagers. Beep does this by replicating what pagers are good at on the Microsoft Teams platform. What are pagers good at? They allow a person to hold a role whilst they hold the pager. If the cardiologist on call is #1234, then everyone knows if they page 1234, it will be responded to by an on call cardiologist. They don't need to consult a diary or a rota to see who is on call at that time. Paging 1234 is enough.

 Beep replicates this functionality using Microsoft Teams' tags. Importantly Beep allows you to send a message to a tag in another team. So, if you're in the A&E team, but not the Cardiology team,Beep allows you to beep the cardiologist on call. 
 Hospitals have used pagers in hospitals for the last 40 years!  The pagers are small radio devices allowing the clinician to receive simple text notifications, often just a four digit extension to be called back on a regular phone. They predate mobile phones and unlike modern mobiles they are typically shared devices, with the pager being passed between colleagues, depending on who is on call. The use of pagers is called ‘paging’. 
 Beep improves on paging in two ways:

  It's 'fire and forget'. Rather than paging 1234 and waiting for the on call cardiologist to call you back, you can send a full request to the cardiologist and track it through to completion.

 With paging, you page them, wait, page again, wait. They call you back. Then they page you. Finally you talk and only then can you discuss the case in hand. This is very inefficient.

 It brings the communication inside Microsoft Teams, improving information governance and clinical oversight.
 
 **IMPORTANT:** 
 Beep is a chargeable service and you must be a Medxnote customer to use the service. Contact [niall.rafferty@medxnote.com](mailto:niall.rafferty@medxnote.com) to organize a demo. In order to use this app. Users must have an active Beep, please contact niall.rafferty@medxnote.com for more details.

Instantly callout sick, plan PTO or UTO, create approval flows, notify your team, and sync vacation and absence directly with your Outlook calendar and auto reply. Admins are equipped with full control over leave types, absence rules, PTO limits, and balance accrual, as well as organizational holidays and blackout dates - configure domestic or international policies for any regional regulation, from UTO & unpaid absence to floating holidays & compensatory TOIL days off, to FMLA, bereavement, and parental leave. Teams are empowered with instant access to balances, requests, approvals, team calendars, and past or future reporting via CSV or external dashboard. Next time you're out sick, just use a quick text from bed to handle OOO and automatically notify exactly the right people.

**Time Tracking, Overtime, and Timesheet Approval**

Simple ‘in' and 'out' elections are all you need to punch in and out and improve your timesheet accuracy. You can use ‘lunch’ or ‘break’ to maintain compliance and make sure colleagues know when you’re away, or set flexible overtime rules, alerts, and controls to get a handle on extra hours. Managers get access to a powerful timesheet approval dashboard to review timesheet details and flag concerns, while keeping the full team in the know with a punch board showing everyone’s status: who’s in, who’s out, who’s wfh, who’s on break or lunch, and who’s absent, sick or on vacation.

For even deeper understanding of time use, track time to projects, clients, or tasks, calculate project rates and billables, monitor milestones and thresholds, and fully analyze time spent using excel or our powerful visualization dashboards. Easily map and manage which employees go with which projects and tasks, and for Atlassian users you can integrate with Jira to track time spent on Jira projects and issues from within Microsoft Teams.

Schedule your employee shifts with our sleek shift planning interface, while keeping your team in the know using Teams. Admins save time with custom alerts, quick-assign templates, and shift criteria, along with access to the master calendar and instant reporting on shift and timesheet data. Meanwhile AttendanceBot simplifies for employees by automatically notifying when shifts are assigned and sending reminders for upcoming shifts. Team members can even look up their schedule and sign-up for unclaimed shift spots right in Teams.

Manage hybrid policies like office capacity or expected WFO each week, then empower your team to plan their own time in the office, at home, on the road, on site, or in the field with simple bookings like “WFH next friday” or “ito Monday.” Create recurring weekly schedules or let employees plan daily, and activate intelligent reminders where you need them. appDefinitions.shortDescription: Effortlessly save, enrich, and extract code snippets.
appDefinitions.description:
Effortlessly save code snippets, workflow context, and other useful developer resources!

In order to use this app, users must have an active Pieces account. Please [install](https://code.pieces.app) and [contact](https://code.pieces.app/contact) our support team if you encounter any issues or need assistance. Please update your Pieces OS if your version is not at least 4.2.3.

**Getting Started**
1. Install Pieces for Personal use. This is required in order to authenticate with the bot.
2. Pieces for Developers Desktop Application is required for Pieces Microsoft Teams Integration to function. Install Pieces [here](https://code.pieces.app).
3. Login to the Pieces for Developers desktop application using the exact same email used to sign in to Microsoft Teams. This is required to establish the connection between your Microsoft Teams and Pieces for Developers.
4. To get started in Teams, authenticate with the Pieces bot by typing “login”. This will enable Pieces to take actions on your behalf, for instance, extract the message content and Save to Pieces.
5. Add Pieces Microsoft Teams Integration to your desired teams and chats.
6. Find a Code Snippet or Message, select the desired message (⋯) / more actions / Save to Pieces. You should see the content within the Pieces for Developers Desktop Application.

**Features**
- Authenticate with Pieces: Login to the Pieces Chat Bot (used to authenticate the bot on behalf of the user and to save snippets to your Pieces for Developers Desktop application).
- Action to Save to Pieces: This will save the message and any code attachments to Pieces for Developers in real-time and enrich those materials with valuable metadata such as related people, a smart description, and related links, including a link back to the original message to reference later.
- @Pieces Save: This message command will save the previous message to Pieces. To enable this feature, you will need to add Pieces to your desired chat/channel.
- Question: This is a message command that will start a conversation with an AI Assistant that will help you answer all your code questions. This is only available within the personal chat with the Pieces Bot.
- @Pieces Discover: This is a message command that will comb through your desired chat/team, identify code attachments, and save them to Pieces.
- @Pieces Enrich: This will select the previous message (code snippet) and enrich it with AI-powered metadata (related links, related people, title, language classification, and more!).
- @Pieces Extract: This will select the previous message (only image files), extract the code from the image via OCR, and enrich the extracted code with AI-powered metadata (related links, related people, title, language classification, and more!).
- @Pieces Unfurl [pieces_shareable_link]: This will take a Pieces-generated shareable link and unfurl the link to display a card within a chat or channel. This card includes a convenient save button that will gather additional Microsoft Teams context. For example, “@Pieces Unfurl https://mark.pieces.cloud/?p=516149bcb1“.
- @Pieces Help: This is a message command that will list all available commands, common errors, and links to documentation/support.
- Note: All message commands will skip messages that include @Pieces commands, and will skip messages that are emitted from the Pieces bot, unless you are using commands within the personal chat with the bot. This enables you to retry a message command if a failure occurs.

**Help**
If you experience any issues, [contact](https://code.pieces.app/contact) our support team or visit our support center [link](https://code.pieces.app/support). Please submit feedback or a Feature Request [link](https://getpieces.typeform.com/to/mCjBSIjF).

Our purpose-built platform helps harness the combined knowledge of your organisation’s experts and systems, empowering organisations with a single source of truth for business knowledge. This leads to higher data trust, faster decision-making, and better business investment outcomes.

We’re architecture veterans who just get it, because we’ve been where you are now. We’ve had C-suite leaders wanting answers to questions about the business, and no obvious way to discover them. To take that knowledge, grounded in reliable data, and layer on key insights and new ideas that could lead to better business outcomes. To do it quickly and efficiently. To make it as simple, accessible and affordable as we could, for every SME on the planet. And to make it possible to continuously learn into the future and help those businesses that wanted us on their journey.

-Create assessments such as Business Fitness for Application cards or Confidentially for Information cards.

botアプリをチームへ追加したら、チームよりbotへ「登録」（@TeaMe Health Check Bot  登録）とメッセージを送信して登録コマンドを実行してください

appDefinitions.shortDescription: TrunkText helps you get fast, accurate answers from your project documents.

TrunkText for Microsoft Teams is an AI-powered tool designed to provide fast, accurate answers from your project documents. Tailored specifically for construction professionals, TrunkText automatically parses and structures data from your project's document set, allowing you and your team to ask direct questions and get instant, reliable answers backed by document sources. This streamlines decision-making and keeps teams informed without needing to dig through piles of paperwork.
Key Features: AI-Driven Q&A: Simply type in your question about the project, and TrunkText will produce an answer along with supporting references from your project documents. Whether you're looking for details from RFIs, submittals, or current schedules, TrunkText retrieves precise answers to help reduce rework and prevent delays.
Seamless Software Integration: TrunkText integrates directly with major construction software services, including Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, P6, CMiC, Egnyte, and InEight. This ensures that all your project documents, from different platforms, are searchable and accessible within Microsoft Teams, providing a central hub for your project’s information.
Focused Document Insights: TrunkText enables quick access to specific details you need for effective decision-making. It pulls the most relevant data from documents like RFIs, submittals, and other key reports, allowing your team to stay informed and act faster.

Audience:
TrunkText is perfect for Project Managers, Superintendents, and General Contractors seeking an efficient, AI-powered solution to manage and query project documentation. By having instant access to project details directly within Microsoft Teams, users can improve collaboration, streamline workflows, and reduce the time spent searching for critical information.

Licensing Information:
To use TrunkText, a subscription is required. Additionally, licenses for the third-party software integrations (such as Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, etc.) are necessary to make full use of the tool's capabilities. These integrations allow TrunkText to pull in project documents from various platforms, making them searchable and accessible directly within Teams.

Important Notes:
The responses generated by TrunkText are powered by artificial intelligence. While we strive to ensure the highest level of accuracy, these AI-generated responses are based on the data available in your project documents and should always be reviewed for accuracy. It's crucial to critically evaluate all AI-generated content and consult the original project documents when making significant project decisions.

For any questions, feedback, or to report inappropriate content generated by TrunkText, please contact our support team at support@trunk.tools.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Reminders for Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
Never forget a thing. Remind yourself or your team members of important meetings, to-do items or even birthdays. Set **personal reminders**, **group chat reminders** or **channel reminders**. You can even set **recurring reminders** (e.g. a team meeting every Monday at 9am)!

**Add the reminders tab to chats or channels**
Manage all reminders for a chat or channel in the Reminders tab. Easily set complex reminders for yourself or others using the powerful scheduling interface. You can even add this tab to Outlook or Microsoft 365 so that you can set a reminder for yourself without switching to Microsoft Teams!

**Set a reminder**
Chat with the bot directly or @ mention it in a chat or channel. Simply use the pattern "[what]" [when] to set a reminder, e.g.
- "Send newsletter" in 20 minutes
- "Call Jennie" at 3:45pm
- "Send report" at 13:15
- "Send annual report" on Aug 15
- "Discuss current revenue numbers" on 13 March at 9am

In a chat or channel simply @ mention the bot to set a reminder for everyone to see:
- @Remind "Server maintenance" on Mar 31 at 8pm
- @Remind myself "check this again" on Monday at 9am

Time zones are also supported, e.g.
- "Standup meeting" at 3:30pm IST
- "Conf call" on 13 February at 10am GMT

**Set recurring reminders**
Here are some ways to format the [when] portion of a recurring reminder for yourself, a group chat or a channel:

- "attend the team meeting" every Tuesday at 11:00
- "daily standup meeting" every weekday at 10am IST
- "turn in expense reports" on the 25th day of every month
- "turn in all reports" on the last day of every month
- "update server" every Monday, Wednesday, Saturday at 10am

For more reminder examples please visit [https://teamsreminder.app](https://teamsreminder.app)

**Set a reminder from a message**
You can set a reminder for yourself from any Teams message. Remind will send you a reminder about the message at the time of your choosing and no one else in your team will be able to see it.
1. Click the ⋯ icon while hovering over a message
2. Select More actions > Remind me about this
3. Choose a timeframe from the list or select Custom to set your own

Use the "list" command to view your current reminders and mark them as complete or simply delete them. Click a reminder to jump back to the conversation.

After setting a reminder the bot will confirm date and time back to you using your current device time.

For more details about how to use this bot and to see all supported date and time formats please visit [https://teamsreminder.app](https://teamsreminder.app).  For any questions or feedback, please get in touch at [https://teamsreminder.app/#contact](https://teamsreminder.app/#contact).

1up's integration for Microsoft Teams provides real-time, AI-powered answers to your questions about the competition. This automated Q&A experience allows you to save time by quickly delivering intel to sales teams and handling common customer objections.

**Get Started**
To get started, please visit [https://1up.ai/microsoft-teams-integration](https://1up.ai/microsoft-teams-integration/)

**What You'll Need**
- A 1up account. If your organization doesn't have one, you can sign up for free.
- A Microsoft Teams chat where you want to use 1up. For example, a Sales Enablement or Competition channel.
- Admin privileges in Teams. You may need your Help Desk or IT Admin to approve the 1up integration for Teams.

**How the 1up Integration for Teams Works**
- 1up's integration with Teams automatically answers questions by referencing the information stored in your 1up Knowledge Base. This includes information 1up gathers from the Internet as well as documents you upload/connect to 1up. When @Ask1up is entered into a chat that has been integrated with 1up, and is followed by a question or request, 1up will return the most relevant AI-generated response.
- If no good answer is available, 1up will save the unanswered question to the Knowledge Base tab of the relevant company's dashboard in the 1up web app. If you provide an answer to that question in the web app, 1up will reference it when similar questions are asked in the future from anywhere, including Teams.

**Support**
- For any issues with this app, please contact 1up by emailing support@1up.ai.
- Note Regarding Inappropriate Content: 1up's content is sourced from external websites and, though rare, may occasionally be inappropriate in nature. Please report inappropriate content to 1up by emailing [support@1up.ai](mailto:support@1up.ai).

**Contact Us**
If you have any questions, you can contact us at [support@1up.ai](mailto:support@1up.ai).

- **Comments** - Project Managers are notified when comments are left on their projects.

In order to use this app, an active subscription for Meisterplan is required.
Not a Meisterplan user? Learn more about our software on the [Meisterplan website](https://meisterplan.com/).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Push Microsoft Teams conversations to Chisel to make informed product decisions
appDefinitions.description:
Push Microsoft Teams messages to Chisel to facilitate feature prioritization decisions.
By pushing the Microsoft Teams messages as ideas to Chisel, you won’t lose out on those valuable insights; instead, keep them stored in one place. Chisel is a modern product management platform that combines roadmaps and powerful, built-in feedback collection tools.  Chisel makes it possible to integrate customer feedback with specific features in the roadmap in real-time.

**Highlighting the features of Chisel’s Microsoft Teams app:**
- Send insights from Microsoft Teams to Chisel as ideas
- Add priority and description to make it easier for team members to make an informed decision with clearer context

Chisel is built for PMs, by PMs. It’s the first unified platform to create roadmaps, collect customer feedback and build internal team alignment - all within one app. Because every company has its own way of building software, Chisel can be tailored to fit your exact infrastructure and systems. To benefit from using this integration, you will need an active Chisel account. [Get started with a 15 day free trial.](https://chisellabs.com)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Empower your workforce with quick, reliable HR support through My HR chatbot.
appDefinitions.description:

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Start calls with Global Call Forwarding Softphone directly from Microsoft Teams.
appDefinitions.description:

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Turn isolated remote workers into deeply connected crews.
appDefinitions.description:
Crewting Coffee-Breaks is an employee matching solution that improves cohesion in hybrid and remote teams. Employees are automatically connected and go directly from Microsoft Teams to the virtual coffee kitchen, which sets Crewting apart from other matching solutions. 

In addition, the moderation of coffee breaks promotes collegial cooperation. Whether it's Icebreaker Coffee, Quiz Coffee or Just Coffee, the virtual meetings ensure a lively exchange between colleagues and uncomfortable silences are avoided by displaying personalized content. 

The shared experiences strengthen the corporate culture and are fun. In addition, a new, cross-departmental communication channel is created that promotes exchange within the entire organization and creates the basis for a holistic transfer of knowledge. 


**Features:**

Coffee Kitchen: Virtual coffee kitchen for a relaxed atmosphere
Quiz Coffee: A fun quiz where colleagues get to know each other
Icebreaker Coffee: In-depth conversations based on your own interests 
Just Coffee: Small talk is also essential for hybrid & remote work
Automated scheduling: Guaranteed exchange through automated scheduling
Calendar integration: Intelligent scheduling with all common calendars
Select matching frequency: Intervals for all needs
Individual group sizes: Customized settings for all teams
AI Matching: Diverse and intelligent matching through artificial intelligence
Moderation: Stimulating conversations that take you out of your comfort zone
EU-DSGVO: Complies with current data protection guidelines

We are already working on new features! 


**Get started:**

1. Install the Coffee-Break ☕️ - Crewting App

Click on Install and select the desired team

2. Start a new configuration 🙌

To set up the coffee breaks, a new configuration must be started. Don't worry, it only takes a minute.

3. Select a boost 🎙️

The boost controls our unique content moderation, which immediately breaks the ice between colleagues in coffee breaks. If this is not desired, Just Coffee can be selected without interactive moderation.

4. Configure the matching settings ⚙️

Several matching options can be activated. Simply select the settings that are most suitable for your team.

5. Start matching 🪄

There is no need to wait for the first matching, as it can be started manually directly after setup.

Your Crewting contact: If you need help, visit our [Help Center].(https://help.crewting.app/en/)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: RoMo helps you discover and recognize the culture role models in your company
appDefinitions.description:
Positive feedback and recognition are the most important, yet very frequently overlooked elements in the path to building company culture and boosting employee engagement. By embedding a simple flow into Microsoft Teams, RoMo makes it very quick and easy for people to recognize role models among them, and keeps employees engaged through voting reminders, notifications, and leaderboards.

And the easier for the users it is, the more data points and rich insights the culture transformation team can get, and this will create positive momentum across the whole organization. RoMo provides you the opportunity to slice the data across different teams or profiles, and reveals the role models of the company culture values. Now you can scale the best practices and fast-track the culture transformation!

Key benefits for the employees

👍 They will have a quick and easy way to give and get recognition
⏰ They’ll get reminded about the company’s core values
📈 The amount of positive feedback in the company will grow significantly
🏆 And the engagement levels can increase further with gamification and achievements

Key benefits for the culture team and management

📆 Culture values will become a part of everyday conversations in the company
 🔎 You will gain deep insights into the current state of culture in the company, diagnosis on what needs attention
🍕You’ll have the ability to slice the data according to teams, locations, seniority, way of working, function, department...
 🕸️ You’ll be able to uncover social connections you were not aware of (especially in remote or hybrid way of working) via our Interactions graph
 🥷 You’ll discover culture Role Models, so you can give them the recognition they deserve and scale their best practices

Now what?

Start using RoMo application with a pilot group of users or the whole team for a one-month free trial period, and later upgrade to the paid version and scale up!

Once application is installed in Teams, the user who installed it first should visit [https://backstage.romoapp.net](https://backstage.romoapp.net) and login to setup RoMo account. Contact our support team for more details [https://www.romoapp.net/contact/](https://www.romoapp.net/contact/).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Track and review procurement-related requests of ORO Labs inside Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:
ORO Labs streamlines your end-to-end procurement across teams, systems, and processes without replacing them. Employees can easily initiate and track requests, while internal stakeholders can automate workflow and achieve compliance with ease. This leads to happy business users, fully compliant processes, and high-quality data to make smarter spend decisions.
With ORO + Microsoft Teams, track, review, and approve requests without missing them from the comfort of your Microsoft Teams app.
No need to juggle between your inbox and procurement tools. No need to log in to your desktop every single time to check for an update or notification.
Here’s how ORO’s integration with Microsoft Teams can help you:
The requester gets notified in Microsoft Team when:
A review is started by a reviewer
A review is completed
A request is approved
A request is denied
A request more info is raised
The task owner gets notified in Microsoft Team when:
A procurement request needs to be reviewed by them
A new approval request comes in
A request is resubmitted
A system task is started
Requested details are submitted by the requester or participants

In order to use this app, you need to have an active Oro Labs account. To get started please visit https://www.orolabs.ai/request-demo

appDefinitions.shortDescription: AVA, AvePoint’s Virtual Assistant, helping users find lost content
appDefinitions.description:
Say hello to AVA, AvePoint’s Virtual Assistant! Our handy help desk assistant is a new addition to the AvePoint family, and we hope you’ll warmly welcome this little chatbot into your office too. So, you might be wondering why you need AVA and how she can help your team. AVA automates common restore requests and other tedious tasks that could cause a help desk ticket backlog…basically making document recovery and restore a cinch. 
Quite simply, AVA makes sure your help desk team and end users doesn’t waste precious time (and money) searching through native Microsoft 365’s recycle bin or AvePoint Cloud Backup data in response to lost item requests, all by empowering users to recover and restore content themselves.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: The SysAid Bot allows you to manage SysAid tickets in Microsoft Teams.

Additional Bot Functionalities (version 1.5):

-   Update tickets with notes, attachments, and screenshots
    
-   View active and recently closed tickets, and their details
    
-   Ability to close and reopen tickets
    

Note: In order to use this app, users must have access to SysAid. Please contact SysAid Customer Care [here](https://www.sysaid.com/support) for assistance.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Collect, aggregate and analyze market intelligence to win more business

appDefinitions.shortDescription: No-code App Builder with Orchestrations.
appDefinitions.description:
Work super smart, stay connected and increase team collaboration with OrchestratorBot for Microsoft Teams, the no-code app builder seamlessly integrated with Oracle JD Edwards, Salesforce and Netsuite to easily build custom business apps with orchestrations and UDOs, and instantly make them available for your entire organization using its unique omni-channel approach.

Add value to your orchestrations by easily turning them into smart, re-usable apps for quick data entry, mass updates, ad-hoc queries, or various approval flows.

OrchestratorBot is the #1 productivity tool to simplify your workflows and easily share Oracle JD Edwards or Salesforce data across your organization with the ability to unlock the power of the ERP system from the comfort of Teams to work smarter together and get more done.

Engage now to increase productivity, improve the flow of information in your business, speed up work with lower budgets and reduced development cost to build apps 5x faster with OrchestratorBot.

Discover the full list of features with the ability to set up Grid Row Actions, integrated Attachments logic to upload and download MediaObject files and text attachments from any app, Linked Botflows feature to set up workflows and receive instant push messages in your notifications center, powerful approval notifications, and the dashboard component to create your own widgets and graphs based on watchlists, orchestrations or 3rd party data sources.

Without a valid subscription, you can only access the demo flows to showcase the functionality of OrchestratorBot inside Teams.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Communicate and send important, urgent, life-safety or emergency notifications.
appDefinitions.description:
Incidents and urgent matters can happen at any time.  Companies/organizations need to be prepared and ready to reach their employees and team members efficiently and quickly .  You can communicate with your contacts by sending important, critical events, and life safety notifications from Everbridge to them within Microsoft Teams, a tool used during their day to day work.
- Your urgent messages will get better visibility and attention.
-  Recipients can respond to confirmation or polling notifications. 
- This is another way to contact constituents to ensure they receive and pay attention to urgent matters that come their way. 
This does not support one-to-one chat with a live person, but allows you to send important messages to your contacts, employees or team members, get feedback and track their responses.  After installing this app, all you have to do is configure your contacts in Everbridge so that you can send them notifications via Microsoft Teams!  You will need an Everbridge account to do this.  If you already have an Everbridge account, you are all set.  If you do not have an Everbridge account, please reach out to us to register for an account.
For more information contact us at [https://go.everbridge.com/contact-us.html](https://go.everbridge.com/contact-us.html)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Remotely support your users from Microsoft Teams using Splashtop SOS.
appDefinitions.description:
Splashtop is integrated with Microsoft Teams to enable your technicians to remotely support your users using the Splashtop SOS service.
You can easily initiate a remote desktop connection to your users’ computers to provide support, directly from within chat window. It takes only a few clicks to start a session. After the support case ends, you can check session history on Session Logs tab. Your users do not need to have any software pre-installed for all this to work.
Splashtop On-Demand Support is a solution optimized for MSPs and IT professionals looking for a fast and user-friendly remote support solution, with high performance and robust security.
**Key features**
- Easily start a remote session to the user’s computer from within a chat.
- Full Splashtop features are supported in a remote session, e.g. file transfer, remote reboot, chat, multi-monitor, copy-and-paste, share technician desktop, etc.
- Review the session logs directly on your Teams UI.
- Remote sessions are fully encrypted.
**Useful links**
- Get started: [link](https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/hc/articles/360062237051)
- Contact us: [feedback@splashtop.com](mailto:feedback@splashtop.com)
- Help support site: [link](https://support-splashtopbusiness.splashtop.com/)
- Sign up: [https://www.splashtop.com/sos](https://www.splashtop.com/sos)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Kadence Desk Booking Integration for Microsoft Teams
appDefinitions.description:

Now your employees can easily find where teammates are working, and book available desks and rooms all within one place. Zero setup, passwords, or training required. Everyone can start booking and checking into spaces using the familiar Microsoft Teams interface, making it effortless for your teams to adopt.

**ROOM BOOKING MADE EASY WITH OUTLOOK INTEGRATION**

Kadence - Hybrid Working - Microsoft Outlook calendar integration enables meetings and room booking all in one place, within the Microsoft Teams app or directly in the calendar.

**USE AI TO BOOK THE SPACES YOU NEED AND FIND YOUR TEAMMATES**

Set up notifications via Microsoft Teams to ensure your teams are checking into their reserved desks or meeting rooms, so unused spaces can be released automatically for others to book.

**GET SET UP IN A FEW SIMPLE STEPS:**

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Lucy by Remixt - Lucy, l'ambassadrice Diversité et Inclusion
appDefinitions.description: *Lucy, c'est votre nouvelle ambassadrice Diversité et Inclusion pour un environnement de travail plus juste et épanouissant.*Prévention du sexisme, du harcèlement sexuel, du racisme ou encore de l'homophobie : ce robot est une véritable experte qui peut être sollicitée à tout moment par vos équipes, directement sur un canal Microsoft Teams dédié.*Quel est le rôle de Lucy ?*-   Lucy forme vos équipes : En 20 minutes seulement par thématique, Lucy donne l'essentiel des connaissances sur un sujet et teste les acquis des apprenants en fin de parcours. Pédagogue et non culpabilisante, Lucy illustre son contenu par des vidéos ludiques, accessibles à toutes et tous, mais aussi des définitions juridiques et des mémos. Chaque parcours est construit avec des experts de chaque sujet.-   Lucy sonde vos équipes : elle récolte le ressenti de vos équipes, et leurs contributions, à travers des questions ouvertes et fermées. L'anonymat des apprenants est garanti.-   Lucy informe vos équipes : utilisez votre nouvel avatar pour communiquer autour des actions menées par votre organisation ! Semaine du handicap, journée du coming-out, du droits des femmes : diffuser vos actions en temps réel !*Comment bénéficier de Lucy ?*Une version gratuite de l'application est disponible sur le store Microsoft et vous permet de vous familiariser avec elle, en testant des extraits de notre parcours sur le sexisme ordinaire.Pour une expérience complète, les utilisateurs doivent bénéficier d'un compte payant chez Remixt. Vous pouvez contacter à cette fin l'équipe Remixt tous les jours de la semaine à cette adresse: hello@remixt.co*Ce qu'on dit de Lucy*Pédagogique et déculpabilisante, elle permet d'apprendre tout en passant un bon moment !Vous pouvez la laisser pour vaquer à vos occupations : elle saura se rappeler à votre bon souvenir tant que vous n'avez pas terminé votre parcours.*A propos de Remixt*Lucy a été créée par Remixt, organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi et membre de la French Tech depuis 2020. Remixt accompagne des organismes privées (Société Générale, Semin, BPCE…) comme publiques (Armée de l'air, CHU de Rouen, Théâtre du Châtelet…)Remixt propose un catalogue de 14 formations et de sondages associés, sur tous les thèmes de la Diversité et Inclusion. Un abonnement vous donnera également accès à un tableau de bord pour suivre en temps réel :-   Le taux de participation, et de complétion-   Les réponses des apprenants aux sondages (anonymes)-   Leurs avis sur nos parcours-   Les certificats générés (80% de bonnes réponses sont exigées pour le test de connaissance en fin de parcours)_[Pour plus d'informations contactez-nous](https://remixt.co/fr/contact)__Lucy By Remixt est uniquement disponible sur  Teams_

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Recebimento de notificações da plataforma da Vaipe
appDefinitions.description:
Com o aplicativo Vaipe para Microsoft Teams você consegue enviar a comunicação de pesquisas para o seu time via um link único. Ou seja, eles recebem a comunicação de forma individual para participar de pesquisas pulses, enviar feedbacks ou fazer indicações de colega inspirador. Para utilizar o aplicativo, é necessário ter uma conta na plataforma de gestão ativa de engajamento de colaboradores da Vaipe. 

O que a Vaipe faz?
Através de pesquisas digitais as empresas dão voz aos colaboradores, empoderam gestores e gestoras de pessoas com dados assertivos e estimulam a troca de reconhecimento e feedback. Com isso, fornecemos dados para que empresas e RHs tomem decisões mais assertivas e eficazes.

Dentre as nossas soluções temos:

Termômetro de engajamento - Com uma pergunta de 0 a 10 "qual é a probabilidade de você recomendar sua empresa como um bom lugar para se trabalhar?" é possível mensurar o engajamento do seu time utilizando a metodologia eNPS.

Pesquisa pulse de clima organizacional - na metodologia Vaipe, são 52 perguntas de resposta sim ou não para você conseguir ter dados sobre as alavancas do seu engajamento e as oportunidades de melhoria. Todas as perguntas têm um campo de comentário não obrigatório.

Influenciadores corporativos - Com a pergunta "Quem foi a pessoa que mais te inspirou no último mês?" é possível incentivar a troca de reconhecimento entre os colaboradores do seu time. Aqueles que receberam indicações podem compartilhá-las por Facebook ou Linkedin! Para os administradores da plataforma, é possível visualizar um ranking dos influenciadores dentro da empresa.

Feedbacks ilimitados - A qualquer momento é possível enviar ou receber feedbacks. Os administradores da plataforma também podem acompanhar o ranking de feedbacks.

Pesquisas personalizadas - Crie e compartilhe pesquisas pulses personalizadas, como termômetro de liderança, pulse de home office, pulse saúde mental, pulse de novo normal ou outras metodologias que você já tem desenvolvida dentro da sua empresa.

As notificações serão acionadas com base na configuração feita pelo administrador. Entre em contato com seu administrador(a) para agilizar a configuração. Informações adicionais podem ser encontradas [clicando aqui](https://central.vaipe.com.br/support/solutions/articles/22000224792-como-os-colaboradores-recebem-a-comunica%C3%A7%C3%A3o-da-vaipe-).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Collaborate more efficiently than ever in your DataMiner monitored environment
appDefinitions.description:
The DataMiner app for Microsoft Teams opens up completely new ways of interacting with your DataMiner System. It lets you collaborate with everyone involved in your operational DataMiner environment more effectively than ever, by enriching your Microsoft Teams conversations with insights and controls from your DataMiner monitored and orchestrated environment.

The app comes with an intuitive chatbot interface that you can use to request information from your DataMiner System or to instruct DataMiner to perform certain actions. Ask DataMiner about the status of your elements, views, services or other DataMiner data sources in a one-to-one or group conversation, and the DataMiner app for Microsoft Teams will provide a detailed status of your request with links to the relevant detailed data in your DataMiner System. 

Users need to authenticate to the DataMiner Cloud Platform before they can execute any commands. They will be limited to the same access rights as they would have in DataMiner Cube. This way, you can keep a close watch on your elements, alarms, metrics etc. together with your colleagues, business partners and customers, in a secure way.

Future versions will also allow taking action directly from Microsoft Teams. Think for example of acknowledging alarms, setting a parameter value, triggering an Automation Script etc. This will allow DataMiner operators to easily take control of the system from anywhere, whenever needed.

**Q: What is DataMiner?**
A: DataMiner is an end-to-end open monitoring and orchestration software platform for ICT media and broadband environments.

**Q: Don't have a DataMiner System yet?**
A: Our sales team can answer questions about the DataMiner services and solutions and provide you with details about special offers. You can contact them using the [contact page](https://aka.dataminer.services/contact).

**Q: How do you configure an existing DataMiner System?**
A: The DataMiner app for Microsoft Teams is available for every DataMiner user with a cloud-connected DataMiner System. appDefinitions.shortDescription: Engage, Empower and Support your learners with your own Microsoft Teams BOT!
appDefinitions.description:
tiLly {today i Learned} is a Microsoft Teams BOT that connects employees to knowledge and expert support, right from their menu in Teams.

By engaging the BOT, employees can access both organisation-specific and managed-service Q&A and content.

Engagement between an employee and subject matter experts, via the BOT, adds further support by organically building the Q&A, ensuring tacit knowledge remains within the business.

The tiLly BOT can be utilised in 2-ways, or a combination of both.

- For organisations to build specific knowledge bases and link to their content resources
- For Partners to include the BOT in their managed service delivery to support clients as part of upskill programmes

**Key Points**

The BOT combines Microsoft provisioned Azure AI and BOT services with value-added features: 

**1. Multiple Service Provision from a Single BOT**

   The ability to connect to more than one Q&A service, facilitating a client's own specific service and provision of managed service Q&A's.

**2. Suggestive Content**

   The ability for the BOT to search content as well as Q&A to widen the knowledge provided.

**3. Expert Connection and Support**

   The ability to escalate a question and connect to an Expert network - allowing the Experts to respond from within their own Teams Channel.

**4. Organically Build Q&A from 1-2-1 Engagements for the Benefit of 1-2-Man**

   Organically adding the question-and-answer pairing (including any attached documents, images etc.) to the Q&A knowledge base, as a result of a question being escalated to an Expert.

**5. Extract Tacit Knowledge and Reduce Risk**

   By organically building Q&A from 1-2-1 engagements, this extracts knowledge from people into a central base, ensuring tacit knowledge stays with the organisation when people leave.

**6. Gamification**

   The employee can rate the answer to their question - supporting gamification of the Expert network.

**7. Analysis**

   Full audit log of all engagement with the BOT:
   - Number of questions asked
   - Most prominent employees asking questions
   - Number of questions escalated to Experts
   - Number of unanswered escalated questions
   - Most prominent Experts in respect to number of questions answered
   - Highest rated Experts
   - Most common subject matter

_Note: The analytics are facilitated by Power BI and as such requires the relevant license. Upon licensing of a paid tiLly subscription, the client will receive an email with a link to access the report._

**8. Fixed Pricing**

   A banded pricing model (including a manged service for M365 Q&A and Learning Videos) removing the complexity of Azure consumption-based services, allowing organisations to budget.

_For further pricing information please visit our website - [Pricing - Tilly Group](https://www.tillygroup.co.uk/pricing/)_

The tiLly partner model supports the extension of managed-service training, knowledge and upskill programmes, in whatever form and context, and addresses a number of common challenges:
- Once the training programmes are complete, how do you connect the people who have been upskilled (the experts) to employees so they are able to provide support?
- How do all employees (and not just the trained ones) access the content provided through your training programmes?
- How do you keep the organisation, Experts and employees up to date on evolving subject matter?
- How can you generate a reoccurring revenue stream from the knowledge your training programmes provide?
- How do you raise your profile to a wider audience that has not commissioned your services but who utilise Microsoft Teams for their day-to-day work collaboration portal?

**Further Information**
- [Help Guide](https://bit.ly/tiLlyHelp)
- [Get Started](https://bit.ly/tiLlyDeployGuide)
- [Contact Us](mailto:tiLly@tillygroup.co.uk)

Cyberday is management system for cyber security and privacy work, that unravels selected requirement frameworks (e.g. ISO 27001, GDPR or cyber essentials) into clear tasks and brings security work close to employee's everyday life - into Microsoft Teams.

Cyberday enables you to demonstrate good cyber security to your own management, customers or authorities. **Cyberday is designed to function fully inside Microsoft Teams,** no separate accounts or user credentials are necessary.

**Work in Cyberday starts by choosing your preferred frameworks.** According to this Cyberday creates a ready-to-execute plan, whether you want to go further towards certification-level or just take care of the most critical cyber security essentials to protect customer data. When you've chosen one or more active frameworks, Cyberday gives you a clear list of pending tasks, so you know which actions will get your cyber security to the selected level. By activating, delegating and executing these tasks your compliance level will start increasing.

**Cyberday comprises of three main content types:**

- **Tasks for admins** - What does our core security team need to do for us to comply with selected requirements?
Cyberday presents you pending tasks according to the chosen frameworks. You will need to work with the tasks by selecting an owner and creating evidence information that demonstrates that the task has actually been done e.g. for an auditor. Assurance information varies according to task types. Some demand filling documentation listings, some demand creating guidelines for employees, some creating and updating reports and some simply typing a short process description.
- **Required documentation** - What kind of listings we need to manage our security and report of our compliance?
Get smart and efficient, ready-to-use templates for cyber security documentation which are utilized by creating links between elements with "mouse clicks", not by typing long text paragraphs and drawing lines in process canvases
- **Guidelines for employees** - What kind of instructions do our employees need to follow, so that they can be secure workers?
You can choose the security guidelines each unit must follow. The bot inside Microsoft Teams ensures everyone knows the cyber security guidelines that are relevant for their role.

Cyberday also includes a **report library**, which helps you to create any compliance-related cyber security report with a single click. Each of the frameworks has different reporting needs, and Cyberday includes an own reporting module for each framework.

As an admin you can create your organization's account and invite the selected key people to the management side.**Other personnel can interact with Cyberday only by accepting guidelines via the Teams bot and the Guidebook view.**

Learn more at [https://cyberday.ai](https://cyberday.ai). _In Finnish Cyberday is called Digiturvamalli._

-Periodic review of Orphan Teams, Creates attestation cases for Shadow IT to review orphan teams.

-Team owners can dive into their inactive teams' analytics and Delete or Archive inactive teams.
-Team owners quickly identify teams without members and Delete or Archive them.
-Teams owners have a central view of teams with guests where they can easily and proactively remove guests from their Teams.
-Teams owners now can quickly identify if the data they are accountable for is compromised with shared links. From the grid Teams, Owners can remove without the need to go to Sharepoint to find the share.

BACKUP AND RESTORE

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Run better meetings, track goals and gain insights into your team's performance.
appDefinitions.description:
Be a high performing team without the annoying admin work. Soapbox helps you streamline objectives, meetings, and morale into one workflow that gets you the results you need. Soapbox is seamlessly integrated into Microsoft Teams video conferencing, group and team chat, and Microsoft Outlook calendar. Whether you’re an onsite or remote team, Soapbox enables your team to stay on top of business objectives while giving managers the tools they need to keep a finger on morale and team performance. 
Feature highlights:
- Collaborative meeting agendas: 1:1, team and one-off meetings
- Goal-setting and tracking
- Conversation starters
- Next steps tracker
- Meeting insights: ML-powered conversational analytics
- Integrated meeting notes
- Real-time employee feedback

Soapbox is great for remote, onsite and distributed teams looking to have real-time or asynchronous meetings.

FEATURES:

•••COLLABORATIVE MEETING AGENDAS•••

Great meetings start with an agenda that everyone has contributed to. People show up prepared, conversations are fruitful, and the meeting is hyper-productive. Soapbox for Microsoft Teams makes meetings better by handling the annoying admin work for you.

With Soapbox, every meeting has a shared agenda, description, meeting notes and follow-up. You can also access over 45 meeting agenda templates to inspire productive meetings!


•••GOAL-SETTING AND TRACKING•••

Collaboratively set business and personal development goals with your team in a way that’s measurable and impossible to forget about. Add milestones and deadlines to help you measure progress from the day you set your goals to the day you hope to hit them!

Empower your team to take ownership of their goals by giving them the space and inspiration needed to set their own. Access over 180+ role-specific and professional development OKR and goal examples across every role in tech.


•••CONVERSATION STARTERS•••

Access hundreds of tried and tested questions to spur insightful and productive conversations at work. You’ll also have the ability to sort questions by:
-Meeting type: 1:1 vs. team meeting
-Role: manager vs. direct report
-Tag: Growth, communication, work, motivation

From ice breakers to growth-focused questions, we’ve got it all in our suggested questions library!


•••NEXT STEPS TRACKER•••

Accountability made easy.

No more post-meeting follow-up you have to chase. Keep your team productive and accountable by using using our action tracker to assign and track next steps across every meeting.


•••MEETING INSIGHTS•••

If you’re only talking about status updates across every one-on-one meeting, you’re actively disengaging your team.

With the power of machine learning, Soapbox will scan every agenda item to learn what topics you’re discussing most and least across every meeting across 4 categories: work, motivation, communication, and motivation.

Based on these findings, Soapbox will offer up helpful resources and suggested questions to help you better balance conversations across every meeting.


•••INTEGRATED MEETING NOTES•••

Collaboratively document discussions, decisions, and next step in Soapbox as you move through your meeting. When the meeting is over, Soapbox will automatically email minutes to all participants.

You’ll also be able to access historical meeting minutes all in one place. Never worry about losing track of meeting minutes ever again.

•••REAL-TIME EMPLOYEE FEEDBACK•••

Automatically send quick post-meeting survey questions after every meeting to track meeting effectiveness, team morale, and performance over time.

Never have a bad meeting again.

With Soapbox, you can be a high-performing team without the annoying admin work. What more could you want?

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Blameless incident management, keeping teams resilient and customers protected
appDefinitions.description:
Blameless supercharges your incident response. Coordinate your team with clear process steps, roles and tasks out of the box so you can focus on resolution. Save your team hours with automated retrospective reports and continually improve with detailed performance data available through reliability insights.

- **Manage incidents without leaving Microsoft Teams**	- Start, show summary, resolve incidents	- Check and act on the incident via the Overview tab	- Consult the help tab under each incident channel- **Coordinate your team to respond quickly and effectively**	- Assign incident roles to users to inherit default tasks	- Provide context to incidents (status, severity, type, description, tags, images, messages)	- Join a dedicated video conference (Teams Video, Zoom, GoToMeeting, Google Meet)	- Manage user tasks (Add, Assign, View)	- Escalate to on-call teams (integrated with Pagerduty)	- Quickly jump to the incident in the Blameless web console (*)	- Connect to the corresponding Jira ticket	- Create follow up actions- **Keep all the right stakeholders informed**	- Customizable automated notifications to stakeholders using CommsFlow(™)

The Blameless SRE platform provides context, guardrails, and automates critical workflows across the software lifecycle. Making teams more resilient and products more reliable with high powered tools for continuous improvement of incident response.
- Incident response- Learning & Retrospectives (*)- Insights & Analytics (*)- SLO Manager (*)

_(*) Available via the Blameless web console. An active Blameless account is required to use those capabilities and enable the Blameless chatbot for Microsoft Teams: Contact Blameless to inquire about subscription options._

For more information about using the Blameless App for Microsoft Teams:
- [Blameless App for Microsoft Teams](https://docs.blameless.com/hc/en-us/articles/9643626042135-Blameless-App-for-Microsoft-Teams) (online documentation)- [Enhancing Incident Resolution with Blameless' Microsoft Teams Integration](https://www.blameless.com/blog/incident-resolution-microsoft-teams-integration) (blog)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Work alongside Darktrace with bidirectional communication and data export
appDefinitions.description:
Darktrace Communicator is a bot aimed at existing Darktrace customers and is designed to work alongside your Darktrace DETECT and HEAL deployments.

The bot allows bidirectional communication and data export from Darktrace DETECT and HEAL into Microsoft Teams - this allows users without direct access to Darktrace to collaborate on incidents through Teams Group Chats.

# Not currently a customer?
This app is built to work with a Darktrace deployment, therefore you would need a valid Darktrace DETECT and HEAL license. You can sign up for a Demo and Trial on the [Darktrace website](https://darktrace.com).

# How to get started?
If you are a Darktrace customer and are looking for some help with setup, it's always a good idea to visit the [Darktrace Customer Portal](https://customerportal.darktrace.com) for documentation or contact your Darktrace representative for assistance getting set up.

To get up and running quickly, you can:
* Make sure you have consented to the app permissions in the [Teams Admin Center](https://admin.teams.microsoft.com)
* Log in to your Darktrace deployment, navigate to System Config > Modules
* Locate "Darktrace Communicator" configuration tile and click on it
* Enter Team and Tenant IDs that you wish to use Darktrace Communicator with and hit "Synchronize"

Once set up you should be able to open any Darktrace Incident from the threat tray, navigate to communications centre and select "Teams" as the communications method.

# Bot capabilities
* Organize Teams chats using the Darktrace platform
* Upload incident reports from Darktrace to chat participants
* Notify users of Darktrace incidents
* Forward messages to Darktrace by tagging the bot

*  Send messages and notifications to teams in a channel.

* When signed in to ArcGIS, you can access a wide array of public and private content, including specific items from your repositories.

**About Esri** 
Esri, the global market leader in geographic information system (GIS) software, location intelligence, and mapping, helps customers unlock the full potential of data to improve operational and business results. Founded in 1969 in Redlands, California, USA, Esri software is deployed in more than 350,000 organizations globally and in over 200,000 institutions in the Americas, Asia and the Pacific, Europe, Africa, and the Middle East, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies, nonprofits, and universities. Esri has regional offices, international distributors, and partners providing local support in over 100 countries on six continents. With its pioneering commitment to geospatial information technology, Esri engineers the most innovative solutions for digital transformation, the Internet of Things (IoT), and advanced analytics. * 100% Microsoft Teams 인앱 방식 지원 : 별도로 웹브라우저의 팝업 없이 모든 기능을 Microsoft Teams 내에서 사용할 수 있습니다.

* Microsoft Teams와의 협업 : 한국형 트리형태 조직도를 사용하여 팀즈의 대화, 채팅, 일정(모임) 공유 및 Exchange 메일발송을 원클릭으로 사용할 수 있습니다.

* 기본 문서 서식 지원 : 17종의 기본 문서 서식을 지원하며, 고객이 필요로 하는 서식들을 지속적으로 개발하여 제공합니다.

* 챗봇은 알림 전용입니다.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: An AI-powered knowledge network for employees to tap into the company expertise.
appDefinitions.description:
Effortlessly connect with the right expertise exactly when you need it. Our AI captures and delivers human knowledge on-demand, fully integrated with Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 Copilot.
Your organization doesn't leverage **Starmind** yet? Please [get in touch](https://www.starmind.ai/contact) to get you started in no time.
With the **Starmind App** you can:
* Find the right people to help with your problem and get unblocked instantly. For example, use Starmind in Microsoft 365 Copilot to access the depth of your colleagues' knowledge by asking for the top three experts in functional programming and information security.
* Have a busy day at work? Ask your question anonymously in the network, and get answers from the right people while you work on your priorities.
* Access high-quality expert answers to questions that have been asked before, preventing you from digging through outdated information.
**Powered by AI, built for human connection**

When you have a question, Starmind connects you in real-time to colleagues with the exact expertise you need - no matter their title or location.
Learn how it works:
1. **Ask:** Need help resolving a problem but don't know who to ask? Type in your question, in your preferred language, right where you're already working — no need to leave your workflow.
2. **Identify:** Starmind's AI core analyzes the question, then consults your AI-based enterprise-wide Expertise Directory to identify the people who can answer.
3. **Connect:** Starmind routes your question to a small number of the most relevant people across your organization, who can respond quickly, providing specialist, tacit knowledge. Questions are answered with a 95% resolution rate.
4. **Capture:** Once your question is answered, Starmind automatically stores the responses, feeding it back to the AI core and making knowledge easily accessible for others in the future. This way if a similar question is asked again, previous questions and responses will pop up automatically.
5. **Learn:** Stay up-to-date on topics relevant to your expertise with personalized feeds, topic subscriptions and [StarGPT](https://www.starmind.ai/stargpt).
This app uses AI-powered expert selection and AI-generated content. Please [contact us](mailto:product@starmind.com) if you want to learn more about our product or our commitment to build fair, explainable and inclusive AI.

Ease of Use
Workplace is built with usability in mind. Administrators can manage and monitor Workplace usage with minimal effort. Tight integrations with Windows Explorer and MacOS Finder and intuitive Online and Mobile interfaces ensure rapid adoption into users existing workflow. Workplace simply works!
Security and Compliance
Over 99.99% uptime alongside HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 compliance means Datto Workplace has a proven track record of keeping business data safe and available 24/7.
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest with 265 bit AES encryption. Data centers are geo-redundant, with regions based in the USA, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Advanced policies and device management ensure data access is controlled and managed. 180-day versioning ensures that you can quickly recover accidentally deleted files or revert to a previous version. 
Getting started
See [www.datto.com/products/workplace](https://www.datto.com/products/workplace/)

You will also need your harvest web address found in your Harvest settings.  Time entry is required for most professional service firms. Accurate, timely billing is integral to business bottom lines. And your clients deserve thorough reports without unnecessary gaps in employees individual reports. With AlignTime, your business can achieve effective, efficient, and intelligent time tracking.  AlignTime is a time management business intelligence (BI) framework that will help businesses understand, monitor, and model hourly time entry. The product currently integrates with Harvest, delivering reports and reminders straight to your business’s Microsoft Teams channels. Reveal early warning signs of projects in trouble. AlignTime enables positive change in employee time entry habits through timely reminders and constant reinforcement via the chat applications.  AlignTime’s future product roadmap includes long term analysis of time entry data so that your model can project success criteria to create predictive analysis. A service link can be shared with patients enabling them to request an appointment.  - **View your patients.** You may view the list of people who have appointments in services where you practice. You can click on a patient to see their previous and upcoming Solo visits, as well as schedule new appointments.  - **View encounters.** You may also view the list of completed telehealth appointments.  - **View care locations.** This is the list of telehealth devices you can connect to. Using care locations is an optional part of Solo.  - **Schedule and start an appointment.** Appointments can be scheduled by the patient or by the care team. To schedule an appointment, you can start by selecting either a service or a patient. Once the patient is checked into the appointment you can click the patient in the queue to join the visit in Solo.  - **See the patient profile during the appointment.** Click the Solo app on the top right of the in-session appointment to see the patient profile.  - **Use native Teams notifications.** In the settings section of your Solo profile you may enable Solo to send native Teams notifications when patients have arrived.  **If you have the practice admin role you can also:**  - **Create clinical services.** Services are typically based on specialty and define the patient and provider populations that will be working together.  - **Configure service options including intake.** Set options such as clinic hours, visit windows, appointment parameters and patient and clinician appointment notifications.  **Your patients will:**  - **Click a link to request an appointment.** If you have shared a general visit request link for your service, patients will be able to click the link to request and register for an appointment. Patients will receive a visit link via SMS or email.  - **Join an appointment.** At the time of their appointment your patients will use the link they received to check in and start their virtual appointment from their device via a web-based patient experience, powered by Teams interoperability, built specifically for the telehealth workflow. Downloading Teams is not required.  To have access to Solo, users must have active Solo accounts from their organization and their virtual care practice must be configured for use with Teams.  Solo includes the ability to text an invitation to patients. This Solo Teams app is available in the U.S. and is not compatible with international phone numbers.  If your hospital or health system is interested in getting started with the Solo virtual care platform you can click [here](https://teladochealth.com/contact/) to contact Teladoc Health.

**What is FormScore?**
FormScore was designed as a simple way to measure your mental well-being. It’s a way to track your moods and be open about how you’re feeling on a scale we can all understand.
10 – Lifetime peak form
9 – Exceptional form
8 – Very good form
7 – Good form
6 – Average form
5 – Low form
4 – Very low form
3 – Extremely low form
2 – Struggling, seek help
1 – Crisis, seek help now

**What can you do in the FormScore app?**
**Chat**: Use the ‘Chat’ Bot to set your FormScore. You can also ask the Bot to show you the FormScore for your team.
**Me**: Use the ‘Me’ tab to access your FormScore data - including your average FormScore, the trend over time and the drivers impacting your Form. This tab is great in helping you develop your self awareness about your wellbeing.
**Discover**: We use your FormScore and the Drivers of Form to provide you with personalised and dynamic content, tips, articles and products, to help you boost or maintain your Form - you can access this in ‘Discover’. Its your very own wellbeing toolkit!


**Checking in with your team**
FormScore can also be used to check in with your team and see how they are doing. We can create different work groups (for example locations, departments, and cost centres) within the FormScore platform so you monitor your immediate team, your department or your whole organisation. 
**Please contact us** if you want to create multiple staff groups/teams - as we can set these up for you. We can also provide detailed analytics to you if you get in touch.


**What about your personal data?**
We never ever share your data with your employer. We will not ever share or sell your data. We anonymise individual FormScores and aggregate these to provide insights to employers - if you give us your permission to do so.
Are you ready to start your FormScore journey? If so, read on for next steps:
Complete the purchase of your subscription for the Microsoft Teams
Email us at **support@formscore.today** and we will send you a form to gather some additional information to get your subscription up and running.
If you need any help, please mail us at **support@formscore.today** and we would be delighted to help!!
So………How are you today?

**Boost teamwork with Vani on Microsoft Teams:**

- **Access Spaces from your channels and chat**: Add Spaces from Vani as tabs in your channels and chats to collaborate effortlessly with your teammates.
- **Meet and work in the same place**: Bring Spaces from Vani into Meetings to brainstorm and work together in real time.
- **Get notifications from Vani right within Teams**: Stay updated on all the important activity from Vani with the Vani notifications bot. Reply to comments, manage teammate requests, and more directly with actionable notifications.

**Do your best creative work. Together**.
Whether you're a marketing team crafting your next campaign, a product team preparing for a launch, or a design studio creating your next big idea, Vani simplifies cross-functional teamwork and helps you go faster from idea to finished product.

**Jumpstart projects with ready-made templates**
Get your team started on common product development processes, marketing exercises, checklists, and process flowcharts with templates designed to get your creative juices flowing.

**Visualize your ideas with ease**

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Bring LawVu to where your users work to boost productivity across every team
appDefinitions.description:
**Raise legal requests inside Microsoft Teams to boost productivity**   
LawVu for Microsoft Teams takes streamlined legal intake to the next level, making it easy to raise legal requests without leaving Microsoft Teams.   
Switching apps and learning new systems means more time and effort to engage Legal, which impacts relationships and quality of service. By bringing intake to your users, you create a more effective partnership between Legal and the business - driving efficiency across every team.   
**How it works**   
LawVu users can raise legal requests inside Microsoft Teams. The app captures all relevant fields, including content and attachments from the original Microsoft Teams message, and creates a matter in LawVu so it’s part of Legal’s system of record.   
Key details of a matter created in Microsoft Teams are visible to all channel members, providing transparency and audit trails anytime.   
**Capabilities**   
* Create new matters from Microsoft Teams   
* Retrieve details about a matter or contract into an Outlook email or a Microsoft Teams message using our search-based message extension   
* Query records in your legal workspace using natural language interaction and Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365   
**Copilot Prompts**   
* Fetch matters related to ’NDA’   
* Fetch matters currently with the status ’On Hold’   
* Fetch contracts in the ’Draft’ status   
* Fetch contracts created since ’June 2, 2023’   
**Requirements**   
* A subscription to LawVu is required. If you don’t have an account, visit [https://lawvu.com/getting-started](https://lawvu.com/getting-started).   
**Known limitations**   
* File attachments on a message may be included in the new matter, however Media files (such as inline images) are not currently supported.   
LawVu is a cloud-based legal operations management software for enterprise businesses.   
* [Sign up and get started with LawVu](https://lawvu.com/getting-started)   
* [Get help using this app](https://help.lawvu.com/en/articles/5953276-microsoft-teams-integration)   
* [Contact us](https://lawvu.com/contact-us)

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Interact with SkillPrism in Microsoft Teams for talent insights & skill updates.

SkillPrism AI Agent

SkillPrism AI Agent, part of the Prismforce Talent Supply Chain Management Platform, empowers enterprises to seamlessly interact using natural language and interactive cards.


In Microsoft Teams, the SkillPrism AI Agent enables users to access critical workflows and key insights via interactive cards. It proactively identifies when it's time to update your resume or skill profile, prompting you with actionable cards—allowing you to take immediate action without leaving Microsoft Teams. It utilizes AI-powered natural language understanding to interpret user messages and intent. When you type a query, AI helps decipher its meaning to provide the most relevant response, ensuring a smooth and intuitive experience.

Key Features

  • Search for Best Matching Users: Simply ask, “Who knows both JavaScript and AngularJS in my team?”.
  • Review and Approve Reportee Skills: Manage skills needing attention and approve or reject directly using phrases like, “Get me my reportee's skills that need approval.” and then “Approve Java for John Doe.”
  • Keep your Profile Updated: Effortlessly update your latest resume and skill information directly using actionable cards.
