Not sure if your company is onboarded? Check with your HR team to confirm access. If your organization is not onboarded yet but wants to explore Prismforce Suite, we would love to help! Contact us at contact@prismforce.ai.

Feedback and Support

We value your experience! If you have feedback or need assistance, reach out to our support team at support@prismforce.com.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Create better interviews with planned questions and real-time feedback

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Marvis® help administrators identify network issues and monitor user experiences
appDefinitions.description:
Invite Marvis to be a part of your Microsoft Teams channel or chat to assist administrators in listing and querying any degraded user or site experiences using advanced AI capabilities. Marvis brings the power of its Conversational Assistant to help network operations identify and root cause any ongoing network issues. Here's what Marvis for Microsoft Teams offers:

- **Seamless Collaboration:** Enhance collaboration among your IT team members by leveraging Marvis within Microsoft Teams. Invite Marvis to an existing Team channel. Query Marvis for user and network insights and collectively work towards optimizing network operations, all in real-time and without switching between different dashboards.

- **Natural Language Interaction:** Communicate with your enterprise networks effortlessly using natural language. No more complex commands or jargon - simply ask questions, troubleshoot issues, and search for devices or documentation in a conversational manner.
     Example - List switches on site KR-site-01 , search network device/client (Wired/ wireless) across org using MAC/Hostname.

- **Instant Answers and Troubleshooting:** Get immediate responses to your network-related queries based on network details. Marvis understands your queries and provides specific answers, enabling rapid troubleshooting and issue resolution, all within the familiar interface of Microsoft Teams.
      Example - tshoot kswamy for last 7 days

- **Centralized Access to Documentation:** Access network documentation and resources right from within Microsoft Teams. Marvis can provide you with the relevant documentation and information you need, making it convenient to find critical network details without leaving the Microsoft Teams interface.
      Example - list steps to configure switch port profiles

Note: To access Marvis on Microsoft Teams, you need to have an active Juniper Mist API Token. To understand how to generate your integration API token, please visit our page: [How to configure Marvis in Microsoft Teams](https://www.mist.com/documentation/marvis-bot-in-teams)

If you want to report an issue with any aspects of Marvis bot or need more information, please reach out to us at [support_marvis@juniper.net](mailto:support_marvis@juniper.net).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Well is a Learning & Development tool for modern managers and their teams
appDefinitions.description:
Well™ is the catalyst to form daily habits that help keep everyone at work safe.

Well™ keeps it real, promotes empathy, encourages self-improvement and builds stronger teams.

With well™ you'll have unlimited access to bite-sized, highly engaging content delivered inside Microsoft Teams, so you can learn within the flow of work, driving behavioral change in the way you and your team operate and engage. You'll also learn how to level up the way you support others.

**Well™ features:**

- **Works the way you work**: Sitting within Microsoft Teams means you can learn and access practical support & guidance without leaving the environment you use most.

- **Built for the modern workforce**: Well's bite-sized content is designed to resonate and be accessible to everyone, including those with auditory, cognitive, physical, speech, or vision impairments, as well as individuals with English as a second language. Our content is accessible in an on-demand library and via daily chat nudges to suit your preferences.

- **Real talk from global leadership experts**: Learn from a diverse group of specialists in the fields of leadership and psychology. Real people, not actors. Real scenarios, not scripts.

**What is psychological safety?**

Psychological safety is a shared belief that everyone can be themselves at work - without holding back. It's the feeling of being able to express your thoughts, take risks, and voice your concerns without worrying about any backlash. It's everyone's role to play.

**Aligned with global legislation**

Well™ aligns with the global standards for psychological safety in ISO 45003. Our learning framework, mapped to over 100 informative videos, addresses various psychosocial hazards to create an environment of psychological safety.

Our content has been designed to help manage the psychosocial hazards outlined in Safe Work Australia's Code of Practice: Managing Psychosocial Hazards at Work.

This app is currently only available in Australia.

To use this app, you must have an active subscription for Well. Please contact our [support team](mailto:support@well.global) for more information.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Stay on top of your conversations with Todoist for Microsoft Teams

Ranked as “the best to-do list right now” by The Verge, Todoist is used by 25 million people to organize work and life and to keep tabs on all those incoming messages.

- Remember deadlines with due dates.
- Build lasting habits with recurring due dates like 'every Monday'.
- Work together on projects by assigning tasks to others.
- Prioritize your tasks with priorities.
- Track your progress with productivity trends.

Happy organizing!

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Upgrade hybrid working: more efficiency, teamwork, engagement and satisfaction.

Then Hybrid Streamliner is made for you! Collaboratively discuss and decide on hybrid working arrangements with your team, gaining insights and clarity on improvements and implementation.**

_Join companies such as Ricardo, ASR, Exact, and Voestalpine in optimizing hybrid work through collaborative efforts that enable and acknowledge feedback from every team member on relevant topics._

- Improved efficiency and productivity through reconsideration of processes and meetings
- Better work-life balance (more clarity, flexibility, autonomy, and freedom).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Make strategic connections to achieve common goals and better outcomes
appDefinitions.description:
Effective collaboration is the key to great work, and the foundation for achieving common goals with better outcomes. Donut makes strategic connections within organizations that boost productivity, build trust, and increase morale.

Donut has made over 15 million connections for 20,000+ enterprises (including Okta and Netflix) within and across departments, office locations, and continents.

**Types of Intros your company can make with Donut for Microsoft Teams**
*New hire networks* – Create a Team just for new joiners to help them build valuable networks that allow them to learn faster, find project sponsors, and reduce time to peak productivity.

*Cross-department connections* – Add Donut to a Team with colleagues from different parts of the organization. Cross-departmental conversations make projects move effectively and efficiently.

*Relationships with leadership* – Add leaders to Teams with direct reports to help build relationships that achieve goals and spread company values.

*Social programs* – Use Donut Intros to help colleagues form lasting relationships that build loyalty through social programs like coffee meetups, and support other initiatives like employee resource groups.

**How Donut for Microsoft Teams works**
It’s simple!
- Add Donut to the Team with the colleagues you'd like to Intro.
- Donut will pair everyone in the Team and send them a message prompting them to connect: they can open a chat or video call right in Teams, or find a time to meet using the Teams calendar.
- If colleagues need to make changes, they can snooze or opt out within Teams.

Have a feature request, feedback, or questions? [We’d love to hear from you via email](mailto:support@donut.ai), or [visit our help center](https://help.donut.ai/en/collections/5834322-donut-for-microsoft-teams-beta).

**What Pyn does**

With Pyn, you can automatically send your employees helpful messages on Microsoft Teams at key moments - from their first day on the job, to a promotion, to their last day - and everything in between.

**How it works**

Changes in your company's HRIS are monitored by Pyn, which trigger a Teams message to an employee, their manager, or other relevant team members. For example, an employee was promoted to manager - Pyn detects the change and automatically sends scheduled communications to the new manager and their manager as well.

The loop that you build yourself will be a mixture of your own texts, videos and tasks together with content you choose to link into the loop, all sorted into the 10 activities in Loops where you can communicate in different ways with your students.

Loops works great as a tool in the classroom, but also for distance learning. To instruct remote students, you can share your screen in an online meeting, but also interact with students in the product between the occasions when you meet.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: 受付システム通知ボットは、Microsoft Teamsで来客を知らせるメッセージを受け取ることができます。
appDefinitions.description:
受付システム通知ボットは、弊社製品「受付システム」の機能の一部です。
受付システム端末から呼び出しが行われた際、担当者宛にボットから通知を受け取ることができます。
お客様がお越しになる際のご対応にお使いください。
来館されるお客様に対して事前に受付番号を連絡しておき、来館時に受付システム端末で受付番号の入力が行われると、受付システム通知ボットから担当者宛にメッセージが届きます。
メッセージには、来館されるお客様に関する以下の情報が通知されます。
・会社名
・代表者名
・人数

お客様の来館情報が担当者に直接通知されるため、来客時の受付を行う専任者を用意する必要がありません。
ボットによるリアルタイム通知のため、お客様をお待たせすることもありません。
受付業務の手間を短縮します。
また、受付システム通知ボットからのメッセージと併せて、メールでも同じ内容の通知を行うように設定することも可能です。

受付システム通知ボットは、業界問わずオフィスを構える全ての方にお使い頂けます。
また利用にあたり特別な権限なども必要ありませんので、導入後はどなたでもお使い頂けます。
本製品は「受付システム」を利用するユーザーごとにインストールしておく必要があります。
個別に端末などを用意する必要もなく、Microsoft Teamsに受付システム通知ボットのインストールを行うのみで利用可能なので、簡単に運用が開始できます。

本製品を利用するには、弊社サービス「受付システム」を契約する必要があります。 
ご利用の際は、弊社サポート窓口までお問い合わせください。
※前述の「受付システム端末」につきましても、別途ご案内させて頂きます。
※ストアからのアプリダウンロードの他、弊社からインストール用のパッケージをお渡しすることも可能です。
ご希望の際はお申し付けください。

このアプリは日本語です。

Should it ever be forgotten or overlooked, the reminder function helps with particularly relevant content - employees are reminded to read something as often as necessary until they have checked it off. Applications built with SAP Fiori elements enable users to share content with other users, allowing them to collaborate based on data in the system.

**Share as Chat**
  Collaborate and quickly resolve issues, if necessary, simply by using Microsoft Teams chat to share a direct link with co-workers. You can provide them with access to a specific state of an SAP Fiori application, for example, so they can easily process any requests you have or tasks that come up. This functionality is available within Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365. 

**Share as Tab**
 Work efficiently with a group of co-workers on specific content that you share in the form of a Microsoft Teams tab. Use the Microsoft Teams environment to work on the same context of an SAP Fiori application and use the tab conversation option in parallel to share ideas, discuss, and collaborate. 

**Share as Card**
 Communicate better with your co-workers using Microsoft Teams by providing a collaborative view that shows application content in a new window and enables you to have a meaningful conversation.
 Depending on the functionality that's enabled for you, you might be able to take direct action from the card, such as unblocking a purchase requisition.
 This functionality is available within Microsoft Teams and Outlook. 

**Notifications for Tasks**
 Get notifications for tasks in your Microsoft Teams Activity Feed that are part of your To-Dos section in My Home, allowing you to quickly start working on tasks directly in Teams. 

**SAP Community Search**
Search SAP Community and share content with co-workers in Microsoft Teams – without having to leave the app. While chatting with a co-worker or a group, click on the three dots below the text field, open the SAP S/4HANA app and enter your search term in the popup window. From the result list, pick the topic you want to share and directly send it to your co-workers. 

**Take advantage of the integration with Microsoft 365 Copilot**
 
 Save time searching for information yourself by asking the AI companion to retrieve the application information you need from the system directly in the Microsoft product you are working on. Refine your prompt, if necessary, and then share the content in a card format. Co-workers can access the card containing real-time business data and take direct action. 
 Try these prompts: 
- Get help in SAP S/4HANA 
- Give me details on the supported sample prompts in SAP S/4HANA 
 For more information, or if you come across any objectionable AI-generated content, or if you have any questions, please contact us at [SAP Support Portal](https://support.sap.com/en/index.html) for Component Id : CA-FLP-EXT-COL. 
**Prerequisites for using the SAP S/4HANA for Microsoft Teams app:**
 To use SAP S/4HANA for Microsoft Teams app seamlessly, your organization must
1. Have the appropriate license for SAP S/4HANA Cloud or SAP S/4HANA to take collaboration to the next level - with the integration of Microsoft Teams. 
2. Assign proper authorizations to you for using this app.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Send custom messages from external systems to Microsoft Teams via HTTP POST.

Webhook Bot is designed to replace the deprecated Incoming Webhook connector in Microsoft Teams. This app enables secure and seamless integration with external systems, allowing you to post messages, alerts, and notifications directly into Teams channels via HTTP POST requests.

With Webhook Bot, you can continue to automate your workflows, receive real-time updates from external applications, and stay informed without needing to leave your Teams workspace.

Usage Instructions:
  1. Install the App: Add Webhook Bot to the desired Team and follow the on-screen setup prompts to configure initial permissions and access.
  2. Generate a Webhook URL: Once the app is installed, Webhook Bot will send a message on the default channel within the installed Team. Select "Create" to generate a unique, secure Webhook URL. You will use this to send data from your external system to Teams.
  3. Configure External System: In your external application or service, set up an HTTP POST request to the generated Webhook URL. Format your payload in JSON according to the provided sample when the Webhook URL was created.
    Example JSON:
    { "text": "Your message here" }

Struggling to get the information you need from Salesforce when you need it most? Stop building endless reports and dashboards — harness the power of AI and get the answers you need from Salesforce just by asking, all within Microsoft Teams.

* **What can I ask Meldus?** Meldus answers all sorts of questions about your Salesforce CRM data, across sales, marketing, customer service and more. Meldus gives you valuable insights from Salesforce, quickly and easily.
    * **Start simple** 🌟 e.g. "Show me our pipeline by stage" or "Give me a summary of our active campaigns".
    * **Get more specific** 🎯 e.g. "Compare open pipe for the Legal and Consulting industries, by salesperson" or "How much deal value is the GM Outreach campaign generating with Harold's customers?".
    * **Get more advanced** 🧠 e.g. "I need to know our sales team leaderboard for open deals, and our top five accounts for pipeline in the Northeast, sorted top down".
* **What else can it do?** Plenty! Use _Question Templates_ as simple building blocks for common questions. When you get a great answer, save a _Favorite_ so it's easy to run again, anytime. Use _Custom Instructions_ to help Meldus understand the nuances of your data, and it'll use them to create more personalized responses.
* **Is Meldus easy to use?** It's as simple as asking a question! No setup required, and no training needed. It's that easy.

**How do I get started?**

Connect to Salesforce (any edition with API access), and get instant answers from your CRM data today. 🚀

**Need help?**

1. **Optimizing your company’s involvement in recruitment.** You can easily invite anyone you want to involve in your recruitment processes (colleagues and external service providers) to instantly attribute, even when they are working remotely, in different time zones, offices, or from home.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Get time back with Check-ins on Microsoft Teams

Here’s where Range can help: It gets your team in sync with a daily Check-in that takes about 5 minutes. With a little upfront focus on getting in sync, your team will have shorter video meetings, fewer chat interruptions, and more time to get stuff done.

_Here’s how it works:_

**Share a Check-in** — Range sends a reminder to your Outlook each morning to help you build a simple habit of planning your day, reflecting on your work, and sharing that with your team as a Check-in. 

**Stay in sync** — As teammates Check-in, you’ll see what they’re working on, right in Microsoft Teams. Just add the Range tab to your team, and you’ll always know what everyone’s working on and the progress they’ve made.

**Better meetings** — Range helps your video calls go more smoothly. Just add Range to your meetings, and you’ll see a sidebar during your call with Check-ins from your team. It enables direct messaging notifications for crucial events such as course and learning path enrollment and reminders for past due and upcoming courses and learning paths. The Reach 360 EU app seamlessly integrates with Microsoft Teams, leveraging its robust communication and collaboration features. Users can access Reach 360 EU notifications directly within the Microsoft Teams interface, enhancing accessibility and convenience. Additionally, the Reach 360 EU app interacts with Articulate 360 to fetch relevant course and learning path data, ensuring accurate and timely notifications.
    
To utilize this app, users must have an active Reach 360 EU account. Integration with Microsoft Teams requires users to have access to Microsoft Teams within their organization's subscription. No additional software installation is necessary, as Reach 360 EU operates within the Microsoft Teams environment.

**Please note:** The Reach 360 EU app is specifically tailored for users in the EU. There is also a US version available called "Reach 360," which caters to users in the United States.
    
    **Capabilities:**
    
    1.  **Direct Messaging Notifications:** Receive instant notifications within Microsoft Teams regarding course and learning path enrollment and reminders for past due and due courses and learning paths.
    2.  **Seamless Integration:** Access Reach 360 EU notifications directly within Microsoft Teams, eliminating the need for switching between platforms.
    3.  **Rich Previews:** Share rich previews of courses and learning paths directly within Microsoft Teams, facilitating collaboration and engagement among team members.
    
    **Limitations and Conditions:**

Please visit our [support page](https://www.articulate.com/support/article/Reach-360-Connecting-Reach-360-and-Microsoft-Teams) for more details.
    
The Reach 360 EU app offers a valuable extension to Articulate 360 users by providing seamless communication and collaboration within the familiar environment of Microsoft Teams. With its direct messaging notifications and rich preview capabilities, Reach 360 EU enhances the learning experience and fosters collaboration among team members.

__Overview__
The integration with eGain Knowledge Hub™ allows employees to get help directly on Microsoft Teams. The platform enables both employees & service-desk agents and other users a range of ways to get information from the common knowledge base, it ensures fast, consistent, and accurate answers. eGain Knowledge Hub™ for Microsoft Teams transforms employee productivity and experience by reducing the time wasted in looking for information and expertise.
__The enterprise knowledge challenge__
According to research firms such as McKinsey and IDC, employees spend 19% of their time looking for information in the course of their workday, not even counting the time wasted in recreating the knowledge they could not find. This results in lost productivity, poor employee and customer experience, poor decisions, and ultimately poor organizational performance.
__How it works__
eGain Knowledge Hub automates routine employee queries on policies, procedures, and functional know-how. Powered by AI and ML, the eGain Virtual Assistant asks clarifying questions, where needed, to better understand user intent and delivers personalized answers from the eGain Knowledge Base which also federates across SharePoint repositories. The solution allows the conversation to be transitioned with full context to live chat, where subject matter experts handle the queries on eGain’s Advisor Desktop, while the user gets their questions answered from within Teams.
__Features__
- Pre-built and easily configurable.
- Connect and chat with an eGain bot.
- Receive accurate responses to your questions from your eGain knowledge base.
- Connect to an agent for real-time chat assistance.
__Benefits__
- Improved employee productivity and experience since less time and effort is spent on looking for knowledge.
- Automated handling of routine employee queries with virtual assistance.
- Answers are presented to employees in the familiar Teams interface. No need to learn a new tool.
- Easy and effective onboarding of new hires.
__Limitations__
The users will need a Per Org App Licence. For licensing information contact-us at:[eGain Contact](https://www.egain.com/contact-us/).
At this time we do not support sending attachments, group chats, adding to teams channel and reacting to messages.

We strongly believe in the restorative power of time off, so in order to promote limitless PTO for all, we’ve designed this free tool to solve PTO pain once and for all: instant requests, seamless management, transparent calendars - everything you need for a healthy time off culture.

🪄 Instant rollout: from the moment you add PTOZEN to your workspace, every user you’ve added can start requesting and approving immediately. While you’re welcome to get fancy with approvers, policies, and permissions on our external dashboard, new users can get going in Microsoft Teams and Microsoft 365 immediately.

⚙️ Configure and customize: tailor your settings and permissions for your unique organization needs, including separate rules and calendars for different locations, departments, and reporting structures. Just visit the admin dashboard using the dedicated button in Microsoft 365.

⚡ Skip the training: we’ve made everything self-explanatory so team members can pick it up from day 1 without training or onboarding.

🪟 See what you need, where you need it: whether you’re looking for your personal history or upcoming team calendars, we surface the information you need exactly where you need it.

🙌 Democratize information: Instead of fielding questions all day, give your employees the power to see and manage their own PTO while staying aligned with team time-off.

♾️ **PTO**ZEN really does have it all:
 * -Outlook integration
 * -Effortless approvals
 * -Real time notifications
 * -On-the-go requests
 * -Insightful reporting
 * -Team calendars
 * -Upcoming notices
 * -Configuration dashboard linked from Microsoft 365, Outlook, and Teams


VISIT PTOZEN.COM for more information or email hi@harmonizehq.com to get in touch with the creators.

With Microsoft Teams for Reward Gateway, you can receive instant alerts for specific updates on your platform and recognise your colleagues directly within Microsoft Teams.
This Microsoft Teams integration is only available to paid customers of Reward Gateway. To become a customer, please click [here](https://www.rewardgateway.com/).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Receive notifications & query fact sheets from your SAP LeanIX workspace
appDefinitions.description:
Take your collaboration to the next level by leveraging our notifications integrated with Microsoft Teams to directly notify your end-users of changes in the workspace! The notification settings in SAP LeanIX allow each user to configure on which topics they want to be notified. These topics include:

  • A Fact Sheet was updated where you are subscribed
  • You were assigned to a To-Do
  • and many more.

Query fact sheet: Now get direct access to information about fact sheets in your workspace from where you collaborate. When you receive a request like:

  • ‘Is Sustainability Management one of our business capabilities?’
  • ‘Who's the responsible application owner of Gainsight?’
  • ‘Has the initiative for the post-merger integration been started?’

You don't need to log into your SAP LeanIX workspace anymore; just search for the fact sheet via a search window in the app for Microsoft Teams.

You can query for those fact sheets in your workspace that an admin unlocked and access basic information such as tags, descriptions, and lifecycles to kick-start your peer conversations.

Get a full overview over the features here.

In order to use this application, users must have an active SAP LeanIX account. Please contact our support team for more details.

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Unleash Bot leverages a preset knowledge to automatically answer questions
appDefinitions.description: Unleash - Your Intelligent Q&A Bot Unleash is your all-in-one knowledge management solution seamlessly integrated within Microsoft Teams. Unleash offers a comprehensive suite of features that transform how your team accesses, shares, and collaborates with information. From AI-based Q&A to real-time collaboration, Unleash empowers your team with a versatile knowledge hub that elevates productivity and streamlines information management. Key Features of the Unleash Bot for Microsoft Teams: 1. Automated Q&A: Unleash’s bot actively monitors your team’s channel content, identifying questions and delivering automated responses from a predefined knowledge base. No more repetitive inquiries or delays in finding answers. 2. Effortless Knowledge Retrieval: Seamlessly integrate Unleash’s bot into your Teams workspace to retrieve accurate information instantly during conversations, eliminating the need to switch between tabs or search for documents. 3. Advances Search: Use natural language queries to find all the information you need - FAST. Who Benefits from the Unleash Bot for Microsoft Teams: - Teams of All Sizes: Unleash’s bot is adaptable, ensuring everyone has quick access to accurate answers, regardless of your team’s size. - Knowledge-Driven Professionals: Professionals relying on accurate information, including project managers and knowledge workers, will find the bot invaluable. - Sales and Customer Support Teams: Provide swift responses to customer inquiries and access product information effortlessly, boosting efficiency. - Remote and Hybrid Teams: Enable effective collaboration and knowledge sharing, no matter where your team is located. Get Started with Unleash for Microsoft Teams: Transform your Microsoft Teams experience with Unleash’s intelligent Q&A bot. Eliminate redundant questions, access information instantly, and empower your team with the knowledge they need at their fingertips. Experience the future of knowledge management in Microsoft Teams with Unleash. Add our bot to your Teams workspace today and see how it can enhance your team’s productivity and efficiency. Notes - In order to use this app, users must have an active Unleash account. Please contact our support team - [support@unleash.so](mailto:support@unleash.so), for more information. If you encounter any issues with the bot or the AI-generated content, please don’t hesitate to reach out to us for assistance at [support@unleash.so](mailto:support@unleash.so).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Build a culture of sustainability within your business, school, or organisation.
appDefinitions.description:
Do you want to be more involved in social or environmental initiatives? Do you want to make a difference alongside colleagues, peers, or friends? Our GiveBack application for Microsoft Teams is here to help!

Giveback helps individuals, teams, or entire organisations create, track and share their social and environmental activities. We utilise AI-powered program automation to provide the inspiration to get started and begin running activities aligned with the global sustainability framework, the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. If you are discussing potential activities to support within a messaging chat, you can use the 'more actions' feature to convert the conversation directly into a new mission card.

Once you have selected the mission that you and your team will support, you can invite others to participate, track progress and measure the impact of each mission. As you complete multiple missions and build your positive impact, the battle will be on to stay atop the GiveBack leaderboard as the most active impact champion across your team or organisation.

From an organisations perspective (whether you are a business, school, college, NGO or otherwise), GiveBack helps nurture a culture of teamwork, impact, and sustainability. By building this culture and the organisations broader sustainability profile, you can position your organisation as an employer of choice helping attract employees or customers.

[For support and frequently asked questions, check out our website](https://givebackcsr.com/support/).

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Streamline the way you work by integrating your Microsoft Teams with Moneypenny
appDefinitions.description:
Let us transfer your calls directly into Microsoft Teams, allowing your entire business to operate in a multi-device environment – without the need for telephone numbers or a Microsoft call plan.
Your Moneypenny Receptionist will manage calls in exactly the same way as they do now, but by connecting your account with us, you and your team will be able to receive calls through Teams. There’s no need to keep asking us to switch from your desktop to your mobile; we’ll be able to reach you wherever you are, no matter which device you’re using.
Complete your quick and easy setup now, simply by adding the Moneypenny app to your organisation and granting us access to your employees on Teams. The app will allow us to run calls through your Azure Portal and enable transfers within the Teams platform using the Notification-only bot.
To use this app, you must have an active Moneypenny account. If you have any questions, please get in touch on +44 345 123 3700.
Let's get started!

appDefinitions.shortDescription: Turn support requests into actionable notifications and keep teams in sync
appDefinitions.description:
HappyFox is a cloud-based help desk software. With built-in features including ticketing, asset, task, and knowledge management. Create recurring tickets or use our other automation features to drastically improve support response time. Our most popular features include canned responses, bulk actions, work schedules, ticket templates, smart rules, and beautiful real-time reporting. HappyFox is easy to set up and offers an intuitive interface.

While you're collaborating with your team on Microsoft Teams, you'll never have to leave Teams to stay on top of your tickets in HappyFox. The HappyFox bot gives you on-the-spot notifications right inside Teams.

Get Instant Ticket Notifications

Stay up-to-date on critical events such as new customer response to an important ticket, or new ticket creation. These notifications can be configured to be sent to any channel of your choice inside your organization. Better yet, you can also perform ticketing actions like sending a reply, adding a private note, or changing ticket properties from within teams.

Make conversations actionable

Collaborate on Tickets and keep agents connected, without having to leave Teams. Directly convert Teams conversations into HappyFox tickets or open up the new ticket creation form - right within your channels.

Search Knowledgebase articles

All your knowledge base articles are right at your fingertips within Teams. You can search and get knowledge base articles by @mentioning the HappyFox bot with a search term.

In order to use this app, users must have an active HappyFox Helpdesk account. If you would like try out Helpdesk, you can book a demo using this link. Please contact our support team (support@happyfox.com) for more details.

This app supports Microsoft Teams.

For installation instructions, please refer to our Knowledge base article:

Configure Microsoft Teams Integration with HappyFox

values.name: AllowToAddGuests

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide application behavior.

values.name: EnableAccessCheckForPrivilegedApplicationUpdates
values.description: Flag indicating if access check for application privileged updates is turned on.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide password rule settings.

values.name: BannedPasswordCheckOnPremisesMode
values.description: How should we enforce password policy check in on-premises system.

values.name: EnableBannedPasswordCheckOnPremises
values.description: Flag indicating if the banned password check is turned on or not for on-premises system.

values.name: EnableBannedPasswordCheck
values.description: Flag indicating if the banned password check for tenant specific banned password list is turned on or not.

values.name: LockoutDurationInSeconds
values.description: The duration in seconds of the initial lockout period.

values.name: LockoutThreshold
values.description: The number of failed login attempts before the first lockout period begins.

values.name: BannedPasswordList
values.description: A tab-delimited banned password list.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for Unified Groups.

values.name: NewUnifiedGroupWritebackDefault
values.description: Default value of IsWritebackEnabled property for newly created Unified Groups.

values.name: EnableMIPLabels
values.description: Flag indicating whether Microsoft Information Protection labels can be assigned to Unified Groups.

values.name: CustomBlockedWordsList
values.description: A comma-delimited list of blocked words for Unified Group displayName and mailNickName.

values.name: EnableMSStandardBlockedWords
values.description: A flag indicating whether or not to enable the Microsoft Standard list of blocked words for Unified Group displayName and mailNickName.

values.name: ClassificationDescriptions
values.description: A comma-delimited list of structured strings describing the classification values in the ClassificationList. The structure of the string is: Value: Description

values.name: DefaultClassification
values.description: The classification value to be used by default for Unified Group creation.

values.name: PrefixSuffixNamingRequirement
values.description: A structured string describing how a Unified Group displayName and mailNickname should be structured. Please refer to docs to discover how to structure a valid requirement.

values.name: AllowGuestsToBeGroupOwner
values.description: Flag indicating if guests are allowed to be owner in any Unified Group.

values.name: AllowGuestsToAccessGroups
values.description: Flag indicating if guests are allowed to access any Unified Group resources.

values.name: GuestUsageGuidelinesUrl
values.description: A link to the Group Usage Guidelines for guests.

values.name: GroupCreationAllowedGroupId
values.description: Guid of the security group that is always allowed to create Unified Groups.

values.name: AllowToAddGuests
values.description: Flag indicating if guests are allowed in any Unified Group.

values.name: UsageGuidelinesUrl
values.description: A link to the Group Usage Guidelines.

values.name: ClassificationList
values.description: A comma-delimited list of valid classification values that can be applied to Unified Groups.

values.name: EnableGroupCreation
values.description: Flag indicating if group creation feature is on.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide prohibited names settings.

values.name: CustomBlockedSubStringsList
values.description: A comma delimited list of substring reserved words to block for application display names.

values.name: CustomBlockedWholeWordsList
values.description: A comma delimited list of reserved words to block for application display names.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide custom policy settings.

values.name: CustomConditionalAccessPolicyUrl
values.description: Custom conditional access policy url.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
        settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide prohibited names restricted settings.

values.name: CustomAllowedSubStringsList
values.description: A comma delimited list of substring reserved words to allow for application display names.

values.name: CustomAllowedWholeWordsList
values.description: A comma delimited list of whole reserved words to allow for application display names.

values.name: DoNotValidateAgainstTrademark
values.description: Flag indicating if prohibited names validation against trademark global list is disabled.

value.description:
Setting templates define the different settings that can be used for the associated ObjectSettings. This template defines
       settings that can be used for managing tenant-wide consent policy.

values.name: EnableGroupSpecificConsent
values.description: Flag indicating if groups owners are allowed to grant group specific permissions.

values.name: BlockUserConsentForRiskyApps
values.description: Flag indicating if user consent will be blocked when a risky request is detected. Administrators will still be able to consent to apps considered risky.

values.name: EnableAdminConsentRequests
values.description: Flag indicating if users will be able to request admin consent when they are unable to grant consent to an app themselves.

values.name: ConstrainGroupSpecificConsentToMembersOfGroupId
values.description: If EnableGroupSpecificConsent is set to “True” and this is set to a security group object ID, members (both direct and transitive) of the group identified will be authorized to grant group-specific permissions to the groups they own.

body.title: Suspicious execution of hidden file
body.description: A hidden file has been launched. This activity could indicate a compromised host. Attackers often hide files associated with malicious tools to evade file system inspection and defenses.
body.recommendedActions:
Collect artifacts and determine scope
�	Review the machine timeline for suspicious activities that may have occurred before and after the time of the alert, and record additional related artifacts (files, IPs/URLs) 
�	Look for the presence of relevant artifacts on other systems. Identify commonalities and differences between potentially compromised systems.
�	Submit relevant files for deep analysis and review resulting detailed behavioral information.
�	Submit undetected files to the MMPC malware portal

Initiate containment & mitigation 
�	Contact the user to verify intent and initiate local remediation actions as needed.
�	Update AV signatures and run a full scan. The scan might reveal and remove previously-undetected malware components.
�	Ensure that the machine has the latest security updates. In particular, ensure that you have installed the latest software, web browser, and Operating System versions.
�	If credential theft is suspected, reset all relevant users passwords.
�	Block communication with relevant URLs or IPs at the organization�s perimeter.

value.recommendedActions:
Collect artifacts and determine scope
�	Review the machine timeline for suspicious activities that may have occurred before and after the time of the alert, and record additional related artifacts (files, IPs/URLs) 
�	Look for the presence of relevant artifacts on other systems. Identify commonalities and differences between potentially compromised systems.
�	Submit relevant files for deep analysis and review resulting detailed behavioral information.
�	Submit undetected files to the MMPC malware portal

Initiate containment & mitigation 
�	Contact the user to verify intent and initiate local remediation actions as needed.
�	Update AV signatures and run a full scan. The scan might reveal and remove previously-undetected malware components.
�	Ensure that the machine has the latest security updates. In particular, ensure that you have installed the latest software, web browser, and Operating System versions.
�	If credential theft is suspected, reset all relevant users passwords.
�	Block communication with relevant URLs or IPs at the organization�s perimeter.

body.title: Suspicious execution of hidden file
body.description: A hidden file has been launched. This activity could indicate a compromised host. Attackers often hide files associated with malicious tools to evade file system inspection and defenses.
body.recommendedActions:
Collect artifacts and determine scope
�	Review the machine timeline for suspicious activities that may have occurred before and after the time of the alert, and record additional related artifacts (files, IPs/URLs) 
�	Look for the presence of relevant artifacts on other systems. Identify commonalities and differences between potentially compromised systems.
�	Submit relevant files for deep analysis and review resulting detailed behavioral information.
�	Submit undetected files to the MMPC malware portal

Initiate containment & mitigation 
�	Contact the user to verify intent and initiate local remediation actions as needed.
�	Update AV signatures and run a full scan. The scan might reveal and remove previously-undetected malware components.
�	Ensure that the machine has the latest security updates. In particular, ensure that you have installed the latest software, web browser, and Operating System versions.
�	If credential theft is suspected, reset all relevant users passwords.
�	Block communication with relevant URLs or IPs at the organization�s perimeter.
